rows.text: Why did I just—
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: There's someone calling for me from some place deeper...
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Where did everyone go?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: These are test sentences I improvised according to the guidelines from the Human and Intellitron Emotional Baseline Test.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: ...You, an Aberration? What're you talking about? Though I gotta say, you do look pretty weird with that mask on.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Ah! You don't... suspect us, do you? I wouldn't exactly call Skott a friend, but we'd never do anything like that to him.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: If the killer is here for the Phantasmoon Games, they might become our enemy soon.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Good thing Himeko entrusted this mission to the two of us... Who would've imagined that the great March herself would be stopped at the doorstep in the very first round?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: But look, don't push yourself too hard, okay, [Trailblazer]? Remember that we've got your back!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Uh, Mr. Yang said he wants to hear what happened between Himeko and her dad...
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Can't blame him for being curious, I really wanna know too!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: You're here, [Trailblazer].
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Himeko hasn't mentioned her father at all in the time since I've boarded. So, what is going on between them? As you were the only one with her at the time, you're the only one I can ask.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Yeah, it really threw me for a sec when you said "Himeko's father." But when you think about it, it's only natural that Himeko has a father, right? Not everyone's like me, thawed out of an ice block.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Fifteen years ago, the Phantasmoon Games of that year came to be remembered as the "Bloodstained Games"... So many parents lost their children. So many people lost those dearest to them.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: One of the victims... was my very own daughter. Upon my return, I stood before the grave, where she was laid to rest.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: ...Her name was Himeko.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: I get where you're coming from, but they've made their choices, and so have I.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: A power for grown-ups only.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Hold it.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: And you are...?
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: Hey! Don't say things like that!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Don't tell me... Himeko, is this... your child!?
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: G—Grandpa!
Hold up, there's been a misunderstanding...
Could you please stop making things worse?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Haha, I haven't seen you in fifteen years, and now I'm a grandfather!? Wait—
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: Who's the father!?
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: That's enough! You are looking at my colleague, a new generation of Trailblazer, my friend, and my companion on the Astral Express... [Trailblazer]. Do you understand now, father?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: You hear that? She called me father! Hahaha!
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: Hello there, [Trailblazer]! Sorry about that, I thought you were Himeko's {M#son}{F#daughter} for a second there.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: I'm a painter. Most of my work involves traveling to different segmenta to complete commissions for my clients...
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: Himeko, I know I've let too many chances to spend time with you slip away.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: Just "slip away"? The first time we met was at mother's funeral. When I was already six years old.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Let's put that aside for now. Were you also too busy with work when I was suffering from a weathering curse?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: I'm sorry... I'm afraid it is.

...You might not believe me, but I've been running around for your sake all this time. All these years, I've been trapped in this "room that represents the past" that I imagenated, and I've never left it.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: You didn't know about me becoming the Express's Navigator either?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Fifteen years, and the Express never stopped here once. You didn't even leave behind so much as a single word to indicate you were still alive. And the Department of Aberration Defense completely sealed all records of what happened during those Phantasmoon Games.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: I did hear many rumors about the Astral Express, though. I even saw the Navigator's name...
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: (Stop Ashveil)
After all, are they really better off like this?
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: And even when curiosity drove me to look up your picture, I still didn't dare believe that the woman so full of poise and grace was my daughter. That she'd grown up safe, becoming a living legend in her own right.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: I thought about contacting the Express, but what if their Navigator was just someone who happened to share the same name?
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: I've been clinging to an absurd notion: that if I never sought the answer, there was still a fifty-fifty chance my daughter was still alive. But if I found the answer, and it was "no"... then she would truly be dead.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: So, Himeko, how did you...
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: I'd rather not tarry here too long. I'll be taking my leave now, Dean.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: The Express has defeated the Supplicant that occupied this school, and prevented another tragedy like the one fifteen years ago. Now it's time for you to fulfill the duties you failed in back then...
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: ...Go comfort those students, and see if you can't figure out how to deal with the media bombardment while you're at it.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Failed in my duties... So, still mad at me.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: [Trailblazer], can we talk?
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: HAHAHAHAHAHAHAH—
rows.speaker: Blazeweaver

rows.text: Sorry, kid, this might be a bit abrupt, but has Himeko ever mentioned her surname to you?
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: I'm a failure of a father... I broke her heart.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: But... what exactly happened fifteen years ago? I can't believe it... She actually survived the weathering curse.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: The shadows withdrew beneath Ashveil's feet like a receding tide, leaving Cinderborne standing alone in the wake of the darkness. As the gloom dispersed, it utterly subsumed his three companions, along with the shadows that tethered them to it, vanishing them without a trace.
You're right. I just didn't realize it quickly enough.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: ...How she got through it, how she survived... none of that's important. What matters is that my daughter is back! That's all I need.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: [Trailblazer], if I may ask a small favor: Would you mind showing me {RUBY_B#Astral Express}where my daughter works{RUBY_E#}?
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: I want to make up for all the care I failed to give her all those years... I want to get to know my daughter better!
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: Thought as much. After all, it's Himeko's dad. So, where is he?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: So, this is the Astral Express? It really lives up to its reputation. It's even more impressive than I imagined.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: As to be expected, of course! It's the place where my daughter works! By the way, what's the pay like for a Navigator? Does the position come with insurance and an annual bonus?
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: Talk about parental love... First thing out of his mouth is asking about her salary! Like I'd have a clue... Help! A little backup here?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Mr. Ryusuke, please rest assured, none of the Express crew ever lack for money. We not only receive support from members of the Genius Society, but also from prosperous commercial worlds such as the Planet of Festivities.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Good, good! Hearing you say that is a huge relief, Mr. Yang!
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: Speaking of which, what kind of work does being a Navigator generally entail?
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: Don't you underestimate Himeko either! Her daily duties include charting navigation routes, calibrating warp jumps, and technical maintenance, not to mention she's always guiding the Nameless on missions.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Hoho, my daughter is really something else, isn't she!
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: Of course! Every time we return safely from a trailblazing expedition, it's all thanks to Himeko's guidance and protection! She's the backbone of the Astral Express!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Hey, come on! You're just trying to stir up trouble!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: My golden principle while working on cases in this world is to keep my curiosity in check and not get involved with matters beyond the case itself... especially things that already look considerably dangerous.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Oh? We got a new passenger?
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: Hmm, this gentleman does look kind of familiar...
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: No wonder he felt so familiar! How are you, Mr. Ryusuke?
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: Hey there, kid, would you mind showing me the way?
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: Right this way, Mr. Ryusuke.
Please wait a moment.
Conductor? So you must be my daughter's superior! Thank you for taking such good care of her all this time!
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: Uh, superior? Th—That's way too formal! It's Himeko who's been taking care of the Express and everyone on it!
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: He's... what is he doing on the Express?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: [Trailblazer], if they do argue, I'm counting on you to play peacemaker.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: It's all my fault! I was just curious about your daily work, so I asked your colleagues to show me around, and I know I didn't ask your permission first. Please don't be mad, Himeko.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: Mad? Why would I be mad?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Mr. Ryusuke, welcome aboard the Astral Express. Is there anything else you'd like to see? I can show you around.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Have you read the new chapter of Fluffy Across the Blue?
rows.speaker: "The Fluffy" Fan

rows.text: Well... uh, I know you'd rather keep your distance from your good-for-nothing father, you're on a journey, and it's rude of me to barge in like this...
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: Excuse me, why don't the two of you go to the Party Car? "Shush," get the drinks ready.
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: That's just our domestic robot's name. Come on, Father, people are resting here. Let's not disturb them. Oh, and [Trailblazer], come with us.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Do you have the slightest clue how to talk to other people!? DO YOU!?
rows.speaker: "The Fluffy" Fan

rows.text: I want to talk about the Phantasmoon Games, not just personal matters.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: They left... Whoa, that's the first time I've seen Himeko be that cold to anyone.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: What're you still doing here? Himeko asked you to go to the Party Car!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I get it, reunions are private, and you don't want to spoil it for them! That's fair, it won't hurt to give them some time.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I hope a drink will help the two of them set aside their past differences.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Himeko, that's the first time I've seen you smile since I've seen you this time.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: ...Even if I could avenge his victims, in the end, it won't bring them back to life.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: People at the Department of Aberration Defense told me that the Herald of Death was executed after his verdict was passed. Even were he to be resurrected, the rules dictate that the same person cannot become a Supplicant twice.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: As for you, Dad, have any clients commissioned you lately? It'd be best if you left this world for a while.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: ...Has Mr. Ryusuke left?
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Yes, I told him to head home for now. After all, what is going on with the Phantasmoon Games has nothing to do with him.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: I'm really sorry, everyone, for bringing my personal family matters onto the Express.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Not at all! Mr. Ryusuke is your family, and that makes him part of our family too. And the most important thing for family is to be together, so he's welcome to drop by any time!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Have you read the new chapter of Fluffy Across the Blue?
rows.speaker: "The Fluffy" Fan

rows.text: Blurry_QR_Colt is the GOAT!
rows.speaker: Comic Reader

rows.text: What happened in the newest issue?
rows.speaker: Comic Reader

rows.text: No spoilers! If you've already read it, don't tell me a thing!
rows.speaker: Comic Reader

rows.text: Madam Pearl sent a message to the Express just now, inviting our Supplicant to a meeting. She'll have a private car waiting for us.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Without proper containment measures, a Calamity-level Aberration can destroy dozens of cities as it spreads... That's the scale we're talking about.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: That's the Department of Aberration Defense's term for them. It usually refers to imagenae infused with Wishpower who have lost control and begun to run amok. Over time, though, it's become a label that gets slapped onto any hazardous entity.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: Yes. The meeting won't be held in some stuffy formal reception room. She would like us to visit and tour the headquarters of a company under her name instead.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Yeah! The Skott we knew was... uh, a really tenacious opponent!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Though, given how he's behaved, he's definitely rubbed a lot of people the wrong way, but I doubt any of it was serious enough to get him killed, right?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Himeko, you know about Pearluxe Corp, right?
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Yeah, I understand what you mean.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Yeah! Even though Skott pops up now and then to give us a bit of trouble... I still feel bad about him dying so suddenly during the Phantasmoon Games like this, and without even knowing why...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Huh? Really?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Of course, it's the biggest entertainment conglomerate in Planarcadia.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Entertainment company?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I'll triumph in the Phantasmoon Games in your stead!
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: The Phantasmoon Games may be dangerous, but I hope you'll be safe and sound.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: That's right, Pearluxe Corp is a titan, dominating the entertainment consumer market, including cartoons, comics, games, toys, and the like. They've cornered half the market.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: A while ago...
Oh! So that's where the "Pearl" in Pearluxe comes from! It's a play on her name!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Did Pearl mention what she wanted to talk about?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: She didn't say much, but she specifically mentioned wanting to discuss the developments regarding the Phantasmoon Games. And that she could provide us with a bit of help.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: You must forgive me, I'm just an old-timer who's lost touch with the times.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: Sorry, I'm just getting on in years. Whenever I see a youngster like you, I can't help but think my {M#grandson}{F#granddaughter} would be about your age by now.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: Helping her opponents in the Aeonic game? Looks like she realizes we are all in the same boat. Perhaps she has also realized that the Phantasmoon Games cannot be artificially manipulated.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: We may be able to get a clearer picture of Pearl's intentions after we meet with her.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Have you heard the tale of the legendary painter Graphia, who hid everything on this planet's surface within a scroll?
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: What I did... doesn't matter anymore.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: Think about it. You've already crossed paths with key figures from numerous factions, and even built rapport with some. You're already a capable Nameless who can more than hold your own!
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Though she holds a high administrative position on this planet, do not forget she is also one of the Ten Stonehearts. You've already dealt with Aventurine on numerous occasions, so you should have ample experience handling members of the Ten Stonehearts.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Hey, don't worry! If things do get messy, yours truly is here to save the day!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Hey, that's not totally true! We get some spending money every time we stop somewhere.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Nice one, [Trailblazer]! Parents can probably relax as long as their kids aren't making less than they are, right?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Looks like March wants to visit too.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Well then, I'll leave this meeting to you two.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Aren't you coming with us, Himeko?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I'd like to talk with my father. Didn't he say he would hand over the records about the Phantasmoon Games from our family history to me...? And honestly, isn't this a good chance for you youngsters to handle things independently?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: I understand. In that case, [Trailblazer], March, and I will be heading out now.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Score, a private car! So, where are we getting picked up?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: You should be familiar with it. It's just under the giant gate next to the @ Plaza.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Exactly.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Isn't that where we first met Sparxie? Since we're getting chauffeured there, why not just come straight to us?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Perfect! I've been wanting to stop by the comic store to grab a copy of Fluffy Across the Blue.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: There may be some information in the family records that could help us... It's just that whenever I think about talking with my father, I can't help feeling uneasy.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: That's not a Himeko we see very often.

Haha... Even someone like me, who is always putting on a composed front, can end up giving everyone a laugh. When you think about it like that, [Trailblazer], the meeting with Pearl doesn't seem so scary, now does it?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Ah, look! There's a convenience store. Mind if I grab a copy of Fluffy Across the Blue while we're waiting?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Is that the comic based on the Express's adventures? Haha, the author sure knows how to tap into what's trending.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: The best part is that the author drew all of us as adorable little animals! Totally fits our personas, don't you think?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Maybe they got stuck in traffic on their way over.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: This is the time we agreed on, no mistake about that... Maybe they got held up in traffic.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: No way! They're professionals, and they work for a huge company! There's no way they'd just bail without saying anything.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: You're super adorable, March Bunny.
I'm truly honored to hear you say so.
rows.speaker: Feiron

rows.text: At present, 16% of Pearluxe Corp's active workforce are mechatrons. In specific business and security contexts, they outperform human staff in protective capability and offer a stronger sense of spectacle and visual appeal.
rows.speaker: Feiron

rows.text: Please, do not concern yourselves with such things. My sole duty today is to ensure everyone reaches Pearluxe headquarters safely and happily.
rows.speaker: Feiron

rows.text: I'm THE protagonist, y'know!
The author is totally infringing on our IP!
Exactly what it says. As an eraser wipes away the doodles of a pencil, so too shall the pain be wiped away.
rows.speaker: Recruiter

rows.text: Of course it's possible! For this is a world blessed by the God of Elation, where Aha has granted us the right to happiness.
rows.speaker: Recruiter

rows.text: Right back atcha, Baseball Raccoon!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Hey, so am I! It's an ensemble comic!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Unfortunately, according to the intellectual property protection laws governing the Pan-Cosmic Trade System, using real-life experiences as creative material doesn't infringe on anyone's rights.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Dang! There goes my payday!
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: In fact, it was recently announced that The Fluffy is getting an animated adaptation, and the copyright for it is currently held by Pearluxe Corp.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: It's a super memorable comic! No way can I miss getting a copy while I'm here. I promise I won't be long, a couple of minutes, tops!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Looks like we got here on the early side. Hmm, since coming to this world, I still haven't had a chance to get a street-level view of the city. How about this: We'll meet up under the @ at the Plaza gate in a few minutes.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Alright, sounds like a plan!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Might as well take a look around, then.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Absolutely insane! Did you see the post I shared?
rows.speaker: Chatting Citizen

rows.text: Sharp eyes, {M#kid.}{F#missy.} Anyone who messes with someone like you is in for a nasty surprise.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: I get it. I can see there's still a bit of doubt in your eyes.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Oh, so your next "miracle" will be... executing the Herald of Death? Can't say I'm surprised.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Hey, you hear the news? ...There was a Supplicant battle at Graphia Academy.
rows.speaker: Chatting Citizen

rows.text: Yeah, I saw it. The online forums are already blowing up.
rows.speaker: Waiting Citizen

rows.text: The Supplicant called Sparxie... How terrifying! Actually using livestreams to spread memetic viruses! Aeons, that's just evil. I can't believe the Department of Aberration Defense is letting someone that dangerous run loose!
rows.speaker: Chatting Citizen

rows.text: I heard her livestream got permabanned. Good thing that Nameless from the Astral Express acted so quickly.
rows.speaker: Waiting Citizen

rows.text: I wonder what the next Supplicant will do?
rows.speaker: Chatting Citizen

rows.text: Sorry, I'm not into comics for kids.
rows.speaker: "Daybreak Warrior" Fan

rows.text: They just released the official concept art for that giant Pom-Pom Robot!
rows.speaker: "The Fluffy" Fan

rows.text: That mech design is totally unrealistic... What's so great about it?
rows.speaker: "Daybreak Warrior" Fan

rows.text: Hey, relax! Now, if we were talking about a fusion between Daybreak Squadron and the raccoon, that would totally get my attention!
rows.speaker: "Daybreak Warrior" Fan

rows.text: Wow. You are unbelievably childish.
rows.speaker: "The Fluffy" Fan

rows.text: Hello there! Would you like to learn more about the Research Society of Happy Smiles?
rows.speaker: Recruiter

rows.text: So, uh... are there any charges or fees?
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Isn't that "Detective Passerby"? What's he doing here?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Is the weight of work and stress in your life crushing you? Check out the Research Society of Happy Smiles!
rows.speaker: Recruiter

rows.text: So, uh... this free?
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Rest assured, the only thing joining our Research Society will cost you is a bit of your precious time.
rows.speaker: Recruiter

rows.text: So, this lady who bears her name...
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: ...Who exactly are you?
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: Fifteen years ago, when I made up my mind to join this Phantasmoon Games, my father wasn't with me.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Even as I fought for my life against the Herald of Death, my father was still off somewhere, wandering the cosmos.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Strictly speaking, ever since I can remember, his presence in my life has been as thin as the air in space...
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: So, I would ask you who bears his name, who exactly are you?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Well, well, well, look at you... What are you getting so worked up over?
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: Just a joke, a joke! It's been fifteen years, after all, and you've grown into such a fine young lady! How could you expect your old man to recognize you right off the bat?
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: So, what's with that gravestone I saw with your name on it, then?
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: When you don't know if you'll live to see tomorrow, there's nothing strange about getting your affairs in order in advance, is there, Mr. Ryusuke?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: ...M—Mr. Ryusuke!?
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: How can you be so formal with your own father? At least call me "dad" like you used to, okay?
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: (Quietly slip away)
Your friend passed away? How terribly sad. But the words he left you have illuminated your path in life.
rows.speaker: Recruiter

rows.text: He told me that if I joined the Research Society of Happy Smiles, I could get rid of my suffering forever, and be eternally happy. That true?
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Of course it's true. Just look at the society we live in. Everyone's suspicious and dismissive of one another, and willing to take dangerous risks just for a little pleasure, for a thrill.
rows.speaker: Recruiter

rows.text: Did you hear about how a streamer took over Graphia Academy and was trying to spread a memetic virus through the internet? And over in Dovebrook, gang violence erupted, and left a pile of corpses in its wake. May the Master of Elation save us all.
rows.speaker: Recruiter

rows.text: Have either of you heard about the tragedy of the "Bloodstained Games" fifteen years ago?
rows.speaker: Recruiter

rows.text: I've heard of it.
Nope, doesn't ring a bell.
Why of course you have, you're the Astral Express's superstar! You've even dug up everything there is to know about something that happened over a decade ago!
rows.speaker: Recruiter

rows.text: Do you not watch the news at all?
We don't even have anything close to the same hair color.
That won't do at all! You're the Astral Express's superstar, there's a ton of things you need to look into before joining the Phantasmoon Games.
rows.speaker: Recruiter

rows.text: There was an awful accident during the last Phantasmoon Games, and many people lost their loved ones and children. It was as if a hole that could never be filled had been drilled into their hearts, leaving only sorrow to accompany them for the rest of their lives.
rows.speaker: Recruiter

rows.text: To escape their suffering, these people who had lost their loved ones gathered together and established a mutual support association. This was the Research Society of Happy Smiles' predecessor.
rows.speaker: Recruiter

rows.text: It's now been well over a decade, and the Research Society continues to help more and more people emerge from the darkness in their lives and step into a brighter, happier future.
rows.speaker: Recruiter

rows.text: Come to think of it, it would be most wonderful if a distinguished person like yourself were also interested in our Research Society! Should you find yourself with a moment to spare, please come and visit our mutual aid society!
rows.speaker: Recruiter

rows.text: Well, if it isn't the "Astral Express's superstar"... Of course it's you. Looks like we really were bound to run into each other.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Ah, "Detective Passerby". What're you doing?
At first, I thought it was just someone else with the same name.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: What, here to catch me again?
Perish the thought! You're the hero who just saved Duomension City! Laying a hand on you would spark public outrage.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: I'm here to do my job. Problem is, you've gone and messed up my investigation!
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: How'd I manage that?
You're investigating some roadside charity group?

Here I was, pretending to be a broke passerby to infiltrate this shady "Research Society." You should've ignored me, but no, you acted like some approachable celebrity waltzing into a supermarket, hijacking my conversation with their recruiter.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: With a star like you here, I can't even test the waters anymore.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: The "Research Society of Happy Smiles"... You think they're just some random charity outfit?
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: You must've heard about the Synwish Syndicate killings in Dovebrook, right? The lead I'm following might be connected to this "Research Society of Happy Smiles." But I'll stop there. Not like you're going to pay for my intel, and none of this is any of your business anyway.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Someone I knew died in that incident.
She rarely talks about herself.
...Ah. Based on your social circle, you wouldn't be talking about the poor IPC sap who was unlucky enough to be there?
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Weathering curse? What's that?
It is said that to achieve such a monumental feat, she made a forbidden exchange, sacrificing both her own life and that of her descendants, resulting in the "weathering curse"...
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: Few descendants carrying the Graphia bloodline have lived past thirty. Most of them wither like flowers while they're still young, skin cracking and peeling like dried paint.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: Himeko was no exception. She was tormented by the curse for years...
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: And what did you do for her as she suffered?

The Elixir Seekers' folk remedies, the Intelligentsia Guild treatments... I tried them all, but nothing could reverse the curse. All the time spent searching for cures only resulted in me not being by her side when she needed me the most.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: ...In the end, I am nothing but a useless father.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: She's safe and sound now. Isn't that what matters?
Planning to avenge him?
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Be careful, the murderer is the Herald of Death. He's dangerous.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: I'm... just a useless son-in-law who married into the family. Strictly speaking, I can't really be considered a Graphia descendant.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: Hahaha... Thanks for your concern. "Be careful"... Been a hot minute since anyone said that to me.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Even so, it's my duty to solve the case. Doesn't matter if nobody pays me, I'll still find the killer, and exact justice on the spot.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Why?
The Nameless don't have much in the way of income.
What? No income? Don't tell me that everyone working for the Astral Express is actually doing volunteer work?
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: I mean, I guess you could say that? But actually, it's more like... Ugh, I'm butchering the explanation... Anyway, it's nothing like what you're thinking!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: We Nameless earn at least as much as you do!
Really? Don't underestimate me, kid. I've got big shots from across the cosmos on my client list. While I wouldn't say my work is worth a king's ransom, my fees are nothing to sneeze at.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: A friend of yours was among the victims?
Because one of the victims happened to be someone I was on fairly good terms with... the fool.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Mm. A fool I happened to be on fairly good terms with.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Revenge killings or turf wars... wouldn't be unusual for gang members to die like that. But dying at the hands of some psycho who kills for kicks? That, I can't accept.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: No matter where you are in the cosmos, which era, regardless of how civilization evolves, some rules will just never change...
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Oooh, let me go tell Pom-Pom what you just said~
If Himeko's the backbone of the Express, then our conductor is the absolute cutest and hardest working of all! Right, Pom-Pom?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Like "an eye for an eye, a tooth for a tooth."
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Allow me to introduce myself. I am Ashveil, the famous detective. You could say your friend and I are acquainted through past clashes.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: We didn't actually fight, though.
I—I don't really know this guy.
We did have a bit of a clash of opinions back at the tavern did we not?
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: That's what you meant by "clash"? Fair enough.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: My, my, celebrities truly are heartless...
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: First time I've ever heard anyone introduce themselves as a "famous" detective...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Mr. Ashveil, why are you staring at me? Is there something weird on my face?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: But it's been way too long since we last saw each other. As your father, I want to get to know you better, make up for all the time we've lost...
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: At least, while you're staying here... please allow me to show you some of the fatherly care and devotion I owe you. Will you?
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: Um... young lady, you're holding a copy of Fluffy Across the Blue, right? Would you mind giving it to me?
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Sh—Shush? ...Alright, I'll go make some tea.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: Give it to you...? This was the last copy in the store, you know!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Me? But this is a father-daughter reunion...
Hey, mister, this isn't about the money!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Oh? Because it was the last one on the shelves? True, true. The last item in stock is like the final slice of cake on a plate, the last prey animal on the plains. It never fails to stir our urge to seize it before anyone else. So—
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Th—Thirty thousand credits, how about that? That's my final offer! I'm not exactly rolling in money here.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Truth is, I'm actually buying it for that foolish friend of mine, the one who died.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Today is his farewell ceremony. I thought I'd buy him his favorite comic to pay my respects.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Me?

Ha, he'd always be rambling on about some raccoon with a baseball bat, and how the journey of the Express would never end, that kinda stuff. I heard those stories so many times, it felt like my ears were gonna fall off.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: But... after all that fuss, I completely missed the chance to buy it! Every store around here is sold out!
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Aww, that's enough! My poor little heart can't handle sob stories like that. Here, Mr. Ashveil, take the comic!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Thank you very much for the comic, young lady. Here's the 30,000 credits, as promised!
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Oh! I heard you're the real-life inspirations for the characters. Since you're here, could I perhaps trouble you to sign it?
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Unbelievable...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Thank you both. If Caustide could see this from where he is now, I'm sure he'd be smiling down on us.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: As a token of my gratitude, I'd like to give you a friendly word of caution, [Trailblazer]: I know you plan to target the Herald of Death and cement your heroic image.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: However, all eyes will be on you during the Phantasmoon Games. On such a public stage, discretion would be wise.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: So, whatever plans you might have for this Herald of Death, why not leave the whole messy affair of revenge to someone who couldn't care less about winning or losing, like me?
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Just like this comic. I'm dead set on getting him.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Is he an acquaintance of yours?
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: I'm just trying to look out for [Trailblazer] here! Even if things do go sideways, Pearl wouldn't dare get mad at {M#an}{F#two} adorable young {M#lady}{F#ladies} like {M#me,}{F#us,} right?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: He's just some weird detective who was passing by.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: It's nearly time for Pearluxe Corp to pick us up. We should get going.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Greetings, crew of the Astral Express! It is my honor to escort you on your visit to headquarters!
So, what're we waiting for? Let's go!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Of course not. I'll be driving and monitoring this vehicle remotely. Please, take your seats.
rows.speaker: Feiron

rows.text: Now that is... astonishing.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Wow! That's one massive robot!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to the headquarters of the Pearluxe Corp.
rows.speaker: Feiron

rows.text: Back when Himeko said this was an entertainment company, I knew their headquarters wouldn't be some ordinary old office building.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: But this is way too much! That giant robot statue... This place is totally like some supersized mecha hangar!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Haha, you're absolutely right! In accordance with the vision of our founder, our lobby was intentionally constructed as you see it now.
rows.speaker: Feiron

rows.text: To realize dreams that far exceed what consumers imagine has always been Pearluxe Corp's core design philosophy, and we have never strayed from it. If any of you are familiar with our company's works, you may recognize this as—
rows.speaker: Feiron

rows.text: "Mechatron Warrior Series," the Daybreak Squadron's base of operations.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Ahaha, looks like Mr. Yang here is quite a fan of our company's animated works!
rows.speaker: Feiron

rows.text: Now, Madam Pearl would like to invite everyone from the Astral Express to take a tour before your official meeting begins. She has arranged for a member of our staff to accompany you, so please wait here a moment.
rows.speaker: Feiron

rows.text: I understand, Mr. Feiron. Thank you for escorting us all this way.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Well then, I'll take my leave. This way, Detective.
rows.speaker: Feiron

rows.text: See you around, everyone!
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Really? Pearl wants us to look around here before the meeting? That seems kinda weird...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Could it be related to her proposed collaboration? Perhaps this is her way of "introducing" her other identity.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: We've set up a venue near Dovebrook, where we offer free psychological counseling and living assistance to all visitors. All our services are provided free of charge.
rows.speaker: Recruiter

rows.text: I... I had a friend who passed away, and he'd mentioned you before. He told me that if I ever ran into trouble, the kind people at the Research Society would help me...
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: It's all good as long as we get a chance to look around, that works for me! Why don't we explore while we wait for our new guide?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Mr. Yang! Over here, quick, come on!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Looks like March's inner explorer has been awakened again. Let's not wander too far this time, shall we?
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Mr. Yang, isn't this your favorite gi-ant ro-bot!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: The Research Society was founded with the sole purpose of healing humanity's incurable inner pain. Following Aha's creed, we aim to spread laughter across the mortal coil and eliminate all suffering.
rows.speaker: Recruiter

rows.text: Eliminate all suffering... what's that mean?
Eliminate all suffering... No way is that possible.
GI-ANT RO-BOT!
EN-GINE OF CRE-A-TION!
Behold the mechatron, standing tall astride the earth!
There's no way that's an Engine of Creation!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I don't know what to say... Except: THIS! IS! AWESOME!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I saw it, please, just keep it down. We're here as their guests, we should be careful about what sort of impression we leave.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Looking more closely, it appears many of this mechatron's components were never installed.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: What a shame! I was hoping to see it finished, to see the completed mechatron! Imagine how it would look in motion! What a glorious sight that would be!
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Really? In that case, Mr. Yang, let's hear it: Which one's stronger, this giant robot or that "Arahato" you designed back when you were an animator?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Seeing as we're on someone else's property, comparing robots from different works would be most disrespectful to the creators themselves.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: C'mon, tell us! Pretty please? I wanna know too!
Comparing things is human nature! We can't help ourselves!
Yeah! Like how Cosmicon Collective players are always obsessed with powerscaling all the characters!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I plan on defeating the Herald of Death. That counts as revenge.
Arahato is an animation all about robots, while Daybreak Squadron is a live action hero drama... The two really cannot be compared.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: What a stereotypically textbook "mature" answer.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: My days of being a hotheaded young man are well behind me, so please, cut this "mature" old man some slack, would you? We don't usually come to a place this cool, so why don't the three of us take a photo under this massive mechatron?
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Now we're talking! Let me set the self-timer, so we can all get in the shot together.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Haha, standing below a huge mechatron like this is just incredible!
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Looks like Mr. Yang's still young at heart after all~
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Hey, [Trailblazer]! Guess which lucky girl just managed to snag the last copy in the whole store— Oh! Uh, who's this?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Where did this extra person in the photo come from?
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: A ghost? But it's daytime! And there's way too many people here anyway!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Who are you!?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Wow, this truly is... a magnificent face!
It's nothing like how it looks on the news... Being able to see it up close feels almost surreal.
Am I too close? Sorry, my bad, I'm not great with personal space.
Oh right, I forgot to show you my ID. Right, here we are! I'm Nihilux, and I work at Pearluxe Corp's Imagenesis Technology Department. I'm a P30 agent who works for the IPC.
Ah, I see... Of course, I'm not asking you to give it away for free. I'll pay for it! The retail price is... 300 credits? I can pay you ten times sticker price... 3,000 credits, what do you say?
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: So, what brings you here?
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Ah! Madam Pearl sent me to the lobby to pick you up!
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: All of you are famous super-cosmic-level heroes whose faces have been all over the news more times than I can count, so of course I recognized you right away and just couldn't help rushing over here to snap a selfie with you! Hehe, hope you don't mind!
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: ...Why are you fighting over a comic book with a kid?
I see. Then hello, Miss Nihilux.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Hello everyone! Starting now, I'll be your tour guide, taking you on a comprehensive and in-depth tour to every single must-visit place in this building!
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: From the mechatron imagenesis that managed to pique Mr. Yang's interest, to Miss March's favorite Fluffy Across the Blue merchandise, I'll reveal all the secrets behind our hottest products!
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Seriously!? I can't wait!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Of course I'm being serious! If there's anything you want to see, learn about, or even get your hands on along the way, anything at all, just let me know!
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Think away, but one person's thoughts alone won't cut it. The bigger the imagenae, the more Wishpower needed to sustain it.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: I wouldn't call it striking it rich, but I'm pretty close to making a sweet little profit.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: (Sign) [Trailblazer]
It's all up to you, [Trailblazer]!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Man and mechatron in perfect harmony! Ready to take a photo?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Because when the masses see your magnificent miracles and wield your extraordinary power, fear and jealousy could turn their "Wishpower" into "Wish-you-ill-power" at the drop of a hat. Forgive the expression, but you get what I mean.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: I'm ready.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Hehehe, I love this one so much! I suddenly have this selfish urge to keep it all to myself.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: You're... a Supplicant?
And don't forget about that exclusive gift you promised!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: You bet! In fact, I'll throw in a normal edition for each one of you as hush money! Come on, let's head to checkout.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: How are you doing? It's my pleasure to serve you.
rows.speaker: Pearluxe Corp Cashier

rows.text: I'd like to present each of our three distinguished guests from the Astral Express with an "Alloy King Pom-Pom" toy model as a gift.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Sure, you got it. For the gift expense record, could you please provide your employee ID?
rows.speaker: Pearluxe Corp Cashier

rows.text: Please charge these expenses to this employee ID.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Huh, this is... Madam Pearl's ID number!?
rows.speaker: Pearluxe Corp Cashier

rows.text: Pearl's ID number?
After all, you are esteemed guests invited by Madam Pearl herself. It would only be fitting for the gifts to be presented in her name.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: I see, please wait a moment.
rows.speaker: Pearluxe Corp Cashier

rows.text: Your "Alloy King Pom-Pom" is all packed up. Would you like to take it with you, or shall we use our delivery service?
rows.speaker: Pearluxe Corp Cashier

rows.text: Why don't we head to the gift shop first? I'll get you all some souvenirs.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Since we still have the tour to go through, please just have it delivered to the Astral Express.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: No problem! Hope you enjoy your visit here!
rows.speaker: Pearluxe Corp Cashier

rows.text: Now that the gifts are done, I'll take you to the mechatron design lab.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: This is the part I've been looking forward to the most.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Ah! You're the—
rows.speaker: Young Man in Gray

rows.text: No way, you're... {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} Raccoon! Ah... no, that's not right, you're [Trailblazer] from the Astral Express! Wow! And is Miss March Bunny herself here too?
rows.speaker: Young Man in Gray

rows.text: ...Hi, I actually prefer to be called by my real name, March 7th. This is Mr. Yang.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: How lucky to meet three members of the Express Crew at once! I'm a huge fan of you all, especially my senior [Trailblazer]! I haven't missed a single episode of Fluffy Across the Blue, and I've even bought all the collector's editions!
rows.speaker: Young Man in Gray

rows.text: How could this guy say he likes [Trailblazer] more than me to my face... Good thing I'm not that petty.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: The monsters that were hiding here seem to have been reduced to nothing.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Who is it? Who could it be? Is that...
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Duomension City has made it through the worst of it! Hero, now it's your call. Do we press on, or wipe out the monsters entirely? Hero, you decide!
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Over here, over here!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Don't worry, March. It's hard to tell if people in this world love the real Express Crew, or just the cute animal crew from The Fluffy.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: I don't just follow The Fluffy series! I've been keeping tabs on all your adventures in Belobog, the Xianzhou, Penacony, and Amphoreus! Though it's such a shame there's so little video footage of the Amphorean War online.
rows.speaker: Young Man in Gray

rows.text: Oh right, I just rewatched the scene where the Trailblazer embarked on another trailblazing expedition in Holy Grail/stay night! Your speech was so inspiring!
rows.speaker: Young Man in Gray

rows.text: Oh right, I have a precious trashcan in my collection at home. If I'd've known I'd meet my senior [Trailblazer] today, I'd have brought that can with me.
rows.speaker: Young Man in Gray

rows.text: Could I ask for your autograph, if that's okay with you? J—Just sign my clothes, please! I'm never gonna wash this ever again!
rows.speaker: Young Man in Gray

rows.text: Haha, you're acting exactly like me from ten minutes ago, kid.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Sorry! I got way too excited!
rows.speaker: Young Man in Gray

rows.text: I'm Warrior Cinderborne from Daybreak Squadron, and my real name... well, my real name doesn't matter. Just call me Cinderborne!
rows.speaker: Young Man in Gray

rows.text: Aww, aren't you the sweetest! But I do have my secret to staying young...
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: That's not true! Let me tell you a secret: I actually have other identities and side gigs.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: If you're not in a hurry, would you mind chatting with me for a bit?
rows.speaker: Cinderborne

rows.text: King Pom-Pom and Pom-Pom are different characters. You really shouldn't be making cross-franchise comparisons!
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: You got that right. Intellectual property is one of the most complicated things in the world.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: As the conductor, Pom-Pom is basically the uncrowned king of the Astral Express, I'd say? We can't exactly call them Pom-Pom Kong, can we?
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Hmm, speaking of souvenirs for the Express, I bet nothing could be more perfect than this toy!
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: A one-of-a-kind souvenir in the entire universe, our conductor will definitely love it!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: It's nothing, really. When heroes from the Astral Express grace our humble establishment, how could we not offer something special? It would be unworthy of your status otherwise.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: I actually don't know much about Daybreak Squadron...
So what do you usually get up to around here?
What brings you to Pearluxe Corp today?
Such modesty from a legendary hero. What a stellar role model for all of us!
rows.speaker: Young Man in Gray

rows.text: Shouldn't we continue with the tour now?

Daybreak Squadron is the most popular superhero drama in Fulwish TV's Mechatron Warrior Series, following the story of young heroes fighting alongside mechatrons against the Shadow Slither to save Planarcadia.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: I never expected... Mr. Yang to be so familiar with our story's background!
rows.speaker: Cinderborne

rows.text: After all, I'm a loyal fan of your show.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: I'm truly honored!
rows.speaker: Cinderborne

rows.text: I'm just a small-time actor, playing a hero on TV. And like how my senior [Trailblazer]'s deeds inspired me, Daybreak Squadron has also motivated people to fight against all challenges in real life!
rows.speaker: Cinderborne

rows.text: Imagenae such as mechatrons, which can be produced and discontinued at will, are the perfect residents for Planarcadia, and perhaps, the perfect IPC employees too.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Hmm, Pearluxe Corp has indeed driven the modernization of imagenae in Planarcadia.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Recently, Fulwish TV got approval from the Department of Aberration Defense, so now the "Magico Mechatron: Daybreak Warriors" from the show can operate in reality. My friends and I are just honored to fight alongside the real Bullet Wyrm!
rows.speaker: Cinderborne

rows.text: Sorry, I didn't quite understand that. So, are you still an actor or not?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: How should I put this... My teammates and I are both actors AND real masked heroes! Whenever disaster strikes the city or evil threatens citizens, we show up alongside mechatron warriors to protect everyone!
rows.speaker: Cinderborne

rows.text: I'm here today to test a mechatron's performance and do some advertising shoots while I'm at it.
rows.speaker: Cinderborne

rows.text: Fulwish TV and Pearluxe Corp have always been partners. Even the squad's transformation mechatron is imagenated by Pearluxe Corp.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: The more popular Daybreak Squadron's drama becomes, the more Wishpower flows into the mechatrons, making the squad shine even brighter in reality. And the more active they are, the better Pearluxe Corp's model kits sell. It's a perfect virtuous cycle!
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Sorry for taking up your precious time with all this chit-chat!
rows.speaker: Cinderborne

rows.text: If the Crew hasn't visited the combat testing area yet, I'd like to volunteer myself as my senior [Trailblazer]'s opponent for the test, if that's alright with you?
rows.speaker: Cinderborne

rows.text: Is that really okay?
Nah, you should take Mr. Yang with you instead!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: The user gave us a five-star review. Thank you for your kind feedback! Your satisfaction and approval are our greatest motivators!
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Uh... anyway, I'll just take it as a default 5-star review. Hope to serve you again next time.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Wouldn't it cause damage to the place?
Oh, you bet! Besides my senior [Trailblazer], my teammates in the Daybreak Squadron are the ones I trust the most.
rows.speaker: Cinderborne

rows.text: I'm already satisfied just knowing that the name Cinderborne will remain in my senior [Trailblazer]'s memory.
rows.speaker: Cinderborne

rows.text: Of course I know your bat could send us all flying with a single hit. This time, we'd like to invite you to experience synchronized mechatron combat!
rows.speaker: Cinderborne

rows.text: The hero of the Astral Express gracing us with guidance and leaving some data would surely make the staff here very happy!
rows.speaker: Cinderborne

rows.text: Me? I'm fine, totally fine. It was no surprise that you took us down without breaking a sweat.
rows.speaker: Cinderborne

rows.text: Huh? Why the sudden apology? It's fine. It was no surprise that you took us down without breaking a sweat.
rows.speaker: Cinderborne

rows.text: Oh, what perfect timing! The combat testing area is also part of today's tour.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: I don't want to give you empty platitudes about humans triumphing over fate. But I do believe that while kindness isn't something you can learn, strength is something you can acquire...
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Silly you, there are plenty of powerful ones in this cosmos, but not everyone with strength chooses to become a Nameless.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Haha, [Trailblazer], that's the weight of fame for ya! Don't let down those kids who look up to you.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Honestly, that's my weakness, I can't allow myself to let adorable kids down.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: That one is not bad either.
rows.speaker: Cinderborne

rows.text: That's the one! That's exactly it!
rows.speaker: Cinderborne

rows.text: First have everyone take part in the assembly process for the mechatron in the control room...
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: You're only realizing that now? That's your greatest advantage in joining the Phantasmoon Games... a story that's already spread far and wide.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: So follow me, everyone!
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: This is Pearluxe Corp's Mechatron Imagenesis Design Lab.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Fifteen years ago, the first mechatrons of Planarcadia were born here, and they immediately gained widespread social influence upon their debut.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Today, mechatrons have become the most common and iconic symbol throughout the streets.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Why didn't you say so earlier?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: You could say that mechatrons are the first, and currently only, imagenae that can be mass-produced on assembly lines.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Say, dear guests, do you know what the first step is to creating an imagenae in Planarcadia?
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Drawing the physical form.
This is THEIR IOU for the Express debt from when THEY were traveling with Akivili, complete with THEIR signature and seal!
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: Not a single rule in the Phantasmoon Games requires Supplicants to engage in combat, so there's no need for hostility between us.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: This is an age-old question: "Do Intellitrons possess a soul?"
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Making a wish to Aha.
Submitting an application to the Department of Aberration Defense?
As expected of the Nameless, you're quite knowledgeable about the customs and culture of the world you've set foot in.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Sorry, but THEY're out of the service area right now. Actually, it's about drawing the physical form...
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: ...Well, in a way, that answer isn't exactly wrong.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: That is correct. But all you need to do is sacrifice a tiny sliver of your reputation.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: A tiny sliver of your reputation.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: But just like how human laws can't control wind and rain, an average of 220,000 unauthorized imagenae come into existence each year through humanity's intentional or unintentional creation, and the Department of Aberration Defense can only turn a blind eye.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Drawing the physical form means humans using brushes to give shape to fictional beings, which was originally the domain of professional artists.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: What could be more inspiring to the people of a world than standing face to face with heroes of the cosmos?
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: There are many ways to take the lead afterward. I'm less concerned about the progress than about the unknown risks our plan might face.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: But here, collective creation and standardized mechatron blueprints have replaced traditional artwork, improving standardized workflow efficiency and reducing Wishpower resource waste. In short, this is THE industrial revolution everyone's been chasing.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: To think that even imagenesis, a skill as magical as this... could be industrialized. I'm suddenly starting to admire the IPC.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: That's nothing! Our company aims to create 2 billion mechatrons for social production and public services before Arcadian Calendar 2030, and that includes special combat mechatrons like the Daybreak Squadron!
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: That's a staggering number, but can the Wishpower of the people here really sustain so many imagenae?
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: That's why Pearluxe Corp keeps churning out animations and hero shows one after another. In other worlds, these are just entertainment, but here, they're legit breeding grounds for spiritual energy.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: All of this shall serve Madam Pearl's grand goals and ideals!
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Hehe~ Sorry, sorry! It's impossible not to stare at a face this amazing! You'll forgive me, right?
Hehe~ Sorry, sorry! It's impossible not to stare at a face this amazing! You'll forgive me, right?
*sigh* You're probably gonna be disappointed then, 'cause I'm totally broke.
Alright, back to square one. First step, let's go print the mechatron structure blueprint.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Mechatron assembly blueprint updated, processing...
rows.speaker: Imagenesis Automated System

rows.text: Just a slightly higher-ranking workhorse, that's all. Not on the same level as those big shots from the Strategic Investment Department who you folks usually deal with.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Galactic Baseballer, we've been expecting you!
rows.speaker: Blazeweaver

rows.text: This is Daybreak Squadron's mechatron. Pretty cool, huh?
rows.speaker: Dawnlance

rows.text: You bet! After all, you're our beloved hero!
rows.speaker: Cinderborne

rows.text: Although the giant shadow crisis in Duomension City has been dispelled, the real battle for you and the Daybreak Squadron is only just beginning.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: [Trailblazer], if we defeat you, we hope you'll accept our invitation to become the "Honorary Phantom Fifth Member of the Daybreak Squadron" and help us safeguard the peace of Planarcadia!
rows.speaker: Blazeweaver

rows.text: You got that right! The fully automated imagenesis blueprint design system perfectly matches your needs. You can meticulously adjust every parameter, or just hit one button to skip it all, and the automated system will always produce results that meet the standards.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: I admire your confidence.
rows.speaker: Blazeweaver

rows.text: Honorary! It's an honorary position!
rows.speaker: Cinderborne

rows.text: Pink, Green... we've got tons of colors, you can set any RGB value you want!
rows.speaker: Dawnlance

rows.text: Hello, please show me your mechatron assembly blueprint.
rows.speaker: Pearluxe Corp Staff

rows.text: (Submit blueprint)
No problem, the blueprint has been recorded. The mechatron parts are ready to go. Hope you enjoy the experience!
rows.speaker: Pearluxe Corp Staff

rows.text: No, no, March and I will just watch you play from the side.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Now then, [Trailblazer], please follow my guidance to complete the mechatron assembly.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: This experience mainly involves assembling three parts: The arm, the shoulder armor, and the Daybreak Blade on the back of the mechatron.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Go for it, [Trailblazer]! Assemble the "Magico Mechatron: Daybreak Warriors" and save our city!
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Alright everyone, I'm heading out!
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Assembly complete. Could the next step be...?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: That's right! With the completion of mechatron assembly, it's time for some heart-pounding combat!
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Mechatron synchronization rate... 39%... 42%...
rows.speaker: Mechanical Voice

rows.text: Your little fanboy, Cinderborne, is eagerly awaiting some pointers from you!
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: While we can't power up this big guy, I've printed a small unit. Now, it's time to show you how a mechatron fights.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: I... merged with the mechatron? Where... where am I now?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Look! Those dazzling colors are like an express train traversing through the stars!
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Enhanced full-body armor, a steadfast shield for the people!
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Roar! Let your blazing soul ignite!
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: What a powerful strike!
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: That's our hero, [Trailblazer]!
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: This strike carries the hopes of all citizens! HYAAAAAAH!
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: What!? Our hero got blocked by an illegal building! City!? What are you doing!
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: No choice left! Smash it to pieces, hero!
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Just focus on dealing with the city's crisis and let Madam Pearl worry about the compensation!
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: This is an official challenge from the Daybreak Squadron, great hero of the Astral Express!
rows.speaker: Blazeweaver

rows.text: Hey Gray, didn't you have something to tell your hero? Now's your perfect chance!
rows.speaker: Blazeweaver

rows.text: My friend, [Trailblazer], you know what? Every time I transform into a mechatron, I imagine I'm you. I think about what you would do when facing danger. It is your adventure stories that give me strength...
rows.speaker: Cinderborne

rows.text: So I'll give it my all from now on. Please don't hold back!
rows.speaker: Cinderborne

rows.text: Now then...
rows.speaker: Blazeweaver

rows.text: Let's settle this on the horizon where the Phantasmoon rises.
rows.speaker: Daybreak Squadron

rows.text: You really got into character! [Trailblazer], that was some great acting!
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Eh... Were we just fighting in a film studio?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Haha, don't tell me you actually thought you were fighting them in a real city? That ain't gonna happen. Madam Pearl's insurance fund would collapse!
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: It doesn't matter if it was a real fight or a fake one. What matters is your experience: Did you have fun?
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Looks like the Daybreak Squadron is waiting for you. You gave them quite a combat lesson, it appears! Why don't you go share a few words with those youngsters?
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: It's a shame though... if [Trailblazer] could really become the fifth member of our team, our recognition would rise even further... after all, many people still think we're just playing hero.
rows.speaker: Azurewing

rows.text: Anyone who perseveres in their own life is a hero indeed!
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: I couldn't have made it this far without some team effort!
Aw, stop it, you're making me blush.
Time's about up. We should meet with Madam Pearl now.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Oh right, wanna say goodbye to your big fan before we go?
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Don't worry, [Trailblazer] won't fly away just yet. As for you, you've been chattering away nonstop... How about giving us a proper introduction so that your idol gets to know you better.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: It's me... I'm just too weak... I'm always hesitant, whether in combat or dealing with life. Even though I know I can never become an amazing hero like you, [Trailblazer], I've always been trying my best to get closer to being like you.
rows.speaker: Cinderborne

rows.text: C—Could you please sign that famous line...
rows.speaker: Cinderborne

rows.text: I'll remember today for the rest of my life! Goodbye, Trailblazer. I hope by the next time we meet, I'll be a true hero just like you.
rows.speaker: Cinderborne

rows.text: Indeed. Rather than the power to rule this world directly, that individual draws even greater strength from Pearluxe. The stories and dreams spun by this enterprise are capable of steering the future of Planarcadia, and of serving as the cradle for new imagenae.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: As an IPC employee, I've said far too much. Your friends are waiting for you in the hall. You should go meet up with them. Don't keep them waiting too long.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Mr. Yang and I watched the whole thing on the screen!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Not only did you assemble the mechatron and give autographs to your fan, but you also got to live out your superhero fantasy... did you have fun, [Trailblazer]?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Haha, Mr. Yang's looking at you with such loving eyes, like a parent watching a kid riding on a carousel at an amusement park.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Indeed, seeing [Trailblazer] so happy reminds me of my younger self. Those were the days...
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: What are you talking about? Mr. Yang, you're still young as ever! Oh right, we've been wandering around here for ages and seen everything there is to see. What's this Madam Pearl really up to?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I understand everything she wanted to show us. There are just a few questions I'd like to confirm with Miss Nihilux.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: ...Miss Nihilux? Wait, where did she go?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Ah, there you all are! We've been looking everywhere for you. The secretary's office sent agent Feld here to keep you company while you wait, but he said he couldn't find any of you...
rows.speaker: Feiron

rows.text: Wait, if Mr. Feld is the one who's supposed to meet us, then who is Miss Nihilux?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Miss Nihilux...? ...Who?
rows.speaker: Agent Feld

rows.text: ...agent Nihilux, an IPC ranking P30, who works at Pearluxe Corp's Imagenesis Technology Department.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: P30? Imagenesis Technology Department? Since when did Pearluxe Corp have an Imagenesis Technology Department...
rows.speaker: Feiron

rows.text: Could she be some kind of corporate spy who snuck into the building?
rows.speaker: Agent Feld

rows.text: This is a real mess. What are those security guards even doing!? Distinguished guests, are you hurt? Or did she trick you into giving her money or anything like that?
rows.speaker: Agent Feld

rows.text: This lady seemed totally legit. She smoothly guided us around the place like a pro. I thought she was one of your people!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I need to report this to security right away. She can't have gone far, let's catch her in the act.
rows.speaker: Agent Feld

rows.text: Then, using this mechatron as a template, we'll build a smaller unit for [Trailblazer] so {M#he}{F#she} can try out the combat test program.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Thank you for your help. Astral Express crew, Madam Pearl has been waiting for quite some time. If it's convenient, shall we head out now? I'll show you the way.
rows.speaker: Feiron

rows.text: Please inform Madam Pearl that the three guests from the Express will arrive shortly.
rows.speaker: Feiron

rows.text: Hello, guests from the Astral Express, nice to see you again.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Thank you for your gracious hospitality, Madam Pearl.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Does Planarcadia really need that many mechatrons?
In some people's eyes, being able to create an infinite army of mechatrons would be even better.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Pearluxe Corp have changed Planarcadia.
Who knows, maybe even stranger imagenae will be created in the future!
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: I understand there was a minor incident in the lower lobby, involving someone impersonating a Pearluxe employee. I hope it didn't spoil your enjoyment.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: We're fine, don't worry about us. But how are things with you? Did you lose any valuable tech, blueprints, or top secret information?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: No, Pearluxe's data firewall remains untouched, and all assets under security network surveillance are intact. The only change is an additional expense claim under my employee ID.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: ...Never mind, I can make a preliminary assessment that this was the result of someone's momentary impulse.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Lately, mishaps have been piling up like dark clouds before a downpour, casting shadows of uncertainty over my plans.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Could you be referring to... the Herald of Death?
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Thirty-three citizens were found dead in the Dovebrook District. In addition, an IPC Specialist assigned to negotiate the purchase of a "Mask of Elation" died in an unexpected incident. This party has made overt threats to public order and is clearly challenging the IPC. My intuition tells me this is only the beginning.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Managing capital and managing a corporation share one thing in common, that is, an aversion to risk and a pursuit of stability. And I bear both responsibilities.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: As the executive officer of Planarcadia, I bear an inescapable responsibility for the safety of this world.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: As one of the Ten Stonehearts, I hope to bring the Phantasmoon Games to a swift and safe conclusion.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Rather than staging another dangerous battle like what happened at Graphia Academy, I hope the Supplicants can show the people of this world miracles of joy and happiness instead of sorrow and rage during the Phantasmoon Games.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Therefore, I'd like to hear what the Express wants from all this. [Trailblazer], please tell me...
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: What's your ultimate goal for joining the Phantasmoon Games?
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Mr. Yang, you're not coming along?
Hmm, I'd like to talk about our ultimate goal for participating in the Phantasmoon Games.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: If I win, I'll give up sharing Aha's power and ask THEM to be the leader of the Anti-Destruction Alliance.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Hmm, I get it. That's actually a brilliant idea.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Planarcadia's administrator is... a Supplicant?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: As we told you before, our strategy is to "become a sail, advance and retreat together." The Astral Express is not a lone Supplicant, since we have our own allies in the Games.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Hypothesis: The Synwish Syndicate's missing mask? I thought it fell into the Xianzhou's hands. Don't tell me... Yao Guang gave it to you guys?
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: An IPC senior executive, Planarcadia's administrator, a member of the Ten Stonehearts, joining the games personally. It certainly has an intimidating ring to it. But when you think about it, isn't this identity precisely the greatest burden Madam Pearl has to overcome?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: A sharp observation, I must say. Quite impressive.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Heck yeah, I wish I could go for another round.
Meh, just so-so.
...How could you just automatically give it a positive rating?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Before we move on to the details of our cooperation, would you like to take a short break and have some tea to wet your whistles, or shall we continue?
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: I've prepared some refreshments for you. Please help yourself.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: This is a specialty from the Xianzhou, a precious item called "mung bean soda" that General Yao Guang gifted me.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: As an Intellitron, I can't enjoy human beverages, so I've specially saved this for my esteemed guests.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Seems we really do have a special connection with these drinks.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Together, we can create a "miracle" for all to witness: an arcadia devoted to the legends of heroes.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: A wise choice.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Doesn't Pearluxe own the rights to The Fluffy?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: What? This guy's the assigned agent?
Now that we've reached an agreement, I'll leave it in your capable hands. My secretary will be in touch to keep all parties apprised.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: I've studied in detail the records of my colleagues' interactions with partners in Penacony, and I was particularly inspired by Aventurine's technique of giving small gifts that symbolize good fortune.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: As your private detective, I must warn you that a grand exhibition of unprecedented scale would make for a perfect opportunity to reenact the "Bloodstained Games."
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: I understand. That's why I have a mission for you: Protect the Nameless at "Star Rail FEST."
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: You actually think they would need my protection with their strength? Don't tell me your extrapolations predict even bigger trouble ahead?
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Just as I thought, I knew something was off about her...
No, not at all.
Hidden beneath each extrapolation, tiny signals of unease keep bubbling up to my thought interface. I must be thoroughly prepared for whatever may come.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Now that you've taken up the mask, let's talk about payment. What do you want? The same as always, money?
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: What the...!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Hey, that's rude!

Before we talk about payment, let's discuss the Herald of Death. Although the Department of Aberration Defense sealed and destroyed all records of the Bloodstained Games, I still managed to uncover some unusual leads...
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: After the Herald of Death incident, the victims' families collectively received compensation so massive it could fill any gaping wound. So I figured, maybe we could find some leads by looking into official Planarcadia expenditures.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: It was you, the omnipresent IPC. To be precise, it was the IPC's Technology Department that paid this astronomical compensation.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Why would a lethal incident on some minor frontier planet cause IPC scientists to hemorrhage funding? Don't tell me they're moonlighting as philanthropists on top of their research work?
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Following the usual human drama tropes, am I supposed to give you a round of applause now? Being able to dig up all this information really shows your connections and capabilities, Detective Ashveil.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: In movies, a big shot like you would usually raise a hand right about now, revealing the dark muzzle of a gun.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: "I'm afraid you've learned too much." And BANG! That's when the gun goes off, and I, the poor sap who uncovered the truth, am supposed to bite the dust.
rows.speaker: Ashveil
