rows.text: Sorry, my hand is on the checkbook and unavailable. Mr. Ashveil, tell me: How many zeros would you like to see on that check for our cooperation?
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Here's the interesting part: This item was nowhere to be found in that year's public financial report. Care to guess whose books this money went through?
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: ...It's not about the money.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Indeed, money isn't the issue. A hundred million credits?
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Are you trying to buy me off like some poor victim's family? Tell me, why did the Technology Department pay to sweep this under the rug?
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: I'm not your lackey, Intellitron! Tell me the answer!
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: 500 million. I could pretend there's a glitch in my calculation process and make it a cool billion for you. Money or answer, your call.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: ...I want the answer.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: The answer is: I don't know much. Hard to believe, perhaps, but as CEO, my power isn't unlimited. Besides...
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: The Herald of Death affair lies fifteen years in the past.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: This world is like an unfinished game of chess that's been dragging on for years. The hidden moves laid by the previous player keep becoming my challenges, even today.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: But since you've invited me to finish this game together, sharing intel is a must.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Three hundred million. I know you've always needed money: For cryosleep, supporting the families of fallen comrades, and for treating those who survived. Isn't this exactly what strategic investment is about? Putting money in the hands of those who need it?
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Reasonable. I'll share what I know about the answer.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Marcus Antali, the Herald of Death, last member of the Intelligentsia Guild's "School of Evolutionary Perfection." Five years ago, his identity was confirmed, and he was executed. Note: Executed in every sense of the word.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Ms. Yabuli, head of the Technology Department, took possession of his belongings, and even I don't have the clearance to access those records.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: ...An unexpected choice. It defies my usual understanding of your decision tree. Note: I say this without sarcasm or ridicule.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: No wonder. So that guy was practically IPC personnel, give or take. That also explains why the Technology Department shelled out the compensation. Yet the method behind this latest killing is identical to the one from years ago, if the Herald of Death is truly dead...
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: A serial killer coming back from the dead is the least of our worries. Even if a serial killer does come back to life, he's still just a serial killer who's been shut out of the Aeonic game.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: What's more concerning is this: Someone wants to exploit the legacy of the Herald of Death. Ms. Yabuli took away everything that man left behind, except for the fear he instilled in the people of this world.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: And during the Phantasmoon Games, not only can miracles trigger Wishpower, but fear too. Based on my extrapolations, the appearance of this new Herald of Death might mark the beginning of the festival spiraling out of control.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: No wonder you're in such a hurry to end the Games.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Mr. Ashveil, I've always respected you, but right now, I need to rely on your strength even more.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: "Respect"... When I was younger, what I really wanted was to make the IPC fear me. The passage of time's not exactly kind, is it?
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Deal, Madam Pearl. But I will require one more form of compensation—
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Whoever this new Herald of Death is, I must deliver justice with my own hands. This time, there won't be any lengthy interrogation.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: By the authority vested in me as CEO of Planarcadia, I pardon all crimes committed in the course of your revenge.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: The only violence within you that comes to my mind is Shuhu.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: The Emanator of Abundance who resurrected time and time again. The monster who turned planets into living beings and merged billions of people into flesh spheres.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: The Xianzhou fears that he is using your body... to resurrect himself.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: So, what's your plan? Kill me again?
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: Oh my, things are getting a little heated. Should I get you both slushies?
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: Thank you.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I'll pass.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: While General Yao Guang's divination may foretell a death battle between us, that doesn't necessarily mean it's the only interpretation.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: My experiences on the Express have shown me time and time again that even fates set in stone aren't entirely immovable.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I have no intention of getting into a quarrel with you, but I need to make sure that the presence of the Stellaron Hunters won't endanger my companions, or the future of this planet.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Thus, I must know your purpose here, Blade. What has Destiny's Slave written in your script?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: He stated this trip would be connected to "Death."
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: There were people from all walks of life at the gathering just now. Workers, suits, students, the elderly, and even mechatrons...
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: ...Should I congratulate you?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Much obliged. In my experience, it's best not to get your hopes up too soon. Prophecies rarely unfold the way you expect.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: However, the General's divination isn't entirely baseless. Ever since my arrival here, I have been feeling restless.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: There's another power here beckoning me.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: Is there another form of Abundance in the world besides you?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Perhaps there is more than one.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: Are you referring to the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus or the Elixir Seekers?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Something far more dangerous.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: Do they have support from other factions?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Unclear.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: As such, I'll keep an eye on you until everything settles, just like you did in the past.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: That's as far as I'll go.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Hah.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: Did you two just agree to some weird collaboration before me?
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: I'll leave that matter in your hands, Silver Wolf.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: I don't get it. That good-for-nothing detective didn't even blink an eye before selling us out to Pearl, and you still plan on working with him?
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: There are things only he can get done.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: Hey, you two. Why the long faces? On land blessed by the Master of Elation, frowning is bad manners~
rows.speaker: Happy Resident

rows.text: Come on, smile! Whether you're hungry or full, poor or rich, The Laughter is with you! Would you be interested in learning about our Research Society of Happy Smiles?
rows.speaker: Smiling Resident

rows.text: Thank you, but I'll pass.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Another one. How many people have been talking to us about "happiness" today?
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Well, six, exactly.
rows.speaker: Tingyun

rows.text: But... what's the Synwish Syndicate case got to do with Miss Fulwish?
rows.speaker: Cinderborne

rows.text: Because that Herald of Death was executed fifteen years ago. That's for certain. The Synwish Syndicate case, on the other hand, has copycat written all over it — and Fulwish is a suspect.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: So just because we're survivors, we automatically become suspects? What, are you going to interrogate me too?
rows.speaker: Cinderborne

rows.text: If that's what you want, Miss Kuchiba can arrange for it later. For now, I just want to ask you a few questions about the Smiles Society.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: It doesn't matter if you have a few or a hundred questions. I have nothing to say to you.
rows.speaker: Cinderborne

rows.text: Fifteen years ago, I was left all alone in this world... The so-called relatives closed in like a pack of hyenas, their eyes fixed solely on the compensation smeared with my parents' blood.
rows.speaker: Cinderborne

rows.text: Abuse, deception, expulsion... to them, I was nothing more than a walking money bag, an eyesore, a "jinx."
rows.speaker: Cinderborne

rows.text: It was the Society that gave me the chance to live the life I have now.
rows.speaker: Cinderborne

rows.text: What about the Synwish Syndicate, then? If I recall correctly, they took care of you once. Old Polwave helped you deal with those relatives.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Listen, Mr. Ashveil. The debt I owe the Synwish Syndicate will be paid. I will avenge them as a member of the Smiles Society as well as the Daybreak Squadron. I'll rip the Herald of Death out from the shadows in their name and see justice served. That is my duty!
rows.speaker: Cinderborne

rows.text: You're in over your head.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: The new Herald of Death is very dangerous. I doubt a handful of actors like you can achieve anything substantial.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: You think we're just a couple of kids playing superheroes with masks, right? Well, you're wrong. My squad mates and I aren't the easy pushovers we used to be, Mr. Ashveil.
rows.speaker: Cinderborne

rows.text: I haven't had my transformation surgery yet, but I can already power a mechatron warrior in battle! WE are real heroes here!
rows.speaker: Cinderborne

rows.text: Boys, let's stay on topic, shall we? I just wanted to have a few words about the Society...
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: I have nothing to say to you either, Miss Kuchiba. Neither of you are getting a word out of me on this.
rows.speaker: Cinderborne

rows.text: Well done, Magnus... Your loyalty to the Smiles Society warms our hearts.
You're... following me?
rows.speaker: Cinderborne

rows.text: Not by choice. These IPC dogs made it clear that they intend to frame Miss Fulwish. We're not going to just let this slide.
rows.speaker: Smiles Society Member

rows.text: Would you look at that, the hunters become the hunted.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: What does it matter? If someone's looking for a beating, we'll gladly give it to them.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Locals say ever since the Synwish Syndicate case, this Research Society of Happy Smiles has exploded in size.
rows.speaker: Tingyun

rows.text: That gang's fall left a power vacuum, and the Research Society of Happy Smiles filled it like a fast-growing fungus. Even those who were once resistant or indifferent got swept up in it.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Hm, I think I'm starting to get a better picture now. Is this, by any chance, tied to what you're preparing to do in the Phantasmoon Games?
rows.speaker: Tingyun

rows.text: Not only me. It might also be tied to the "Ominous Fate" General Yao Guang warned about... The one looming over this world.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Yes, cheerful, happy laughter echoing in their heads.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: (Heh heh... Without those gangsters, this street's much cleaner now, hahaha!)
rows.speaker: Happy Thoughts

rows.text: (Hahahahaha—)
rows.speaker: Happy Thoughts

rows.text: The so-called "voice of Aha" those society recruiters claim to hear? Could the Joyseeker truly be so passionate about universal redemption?
rows.speaker: Tingyun

rows.text: Whatever that is, it's not Aha's laughter.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: From the moment I set foot on this street, I've been using my tuning ability to sense the residents' minds. Miss Tingyun, allow me to correct you... those connected to the Research Society of Happy Smiles number not six, but forty-two.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Each of them carries the same sound: identical laughter, looping endlessly like a broken record.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Mind control? Or... something worse?
rows.speaker: Tingyun

rows.text: Are you trying to say that this is tied to the Harmony?
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: My apologies. I dare not make such wild assumptions.
rows.speaker: Tingyun

rows.text: No. This isn't the work of any Tuner. It feels like a barrier, born from the human mind itself, to numb the unbearable pain it cannot endure.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Like a worn out tape recorder hidden deep in the subconscious, repeating the same thing over and over: "I am happy. I am happy."
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: So... whose divine handiwork is this supposed to be now?
rows.speaker: Tingyun

rows.text: Wherever this laughter comes from, causing so many people to self-deceive in perfect unison while enduring pain is well beyond the capabilities of a mere charitable group.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Beneath these calm waters, the undercurrents are far more turbulent than anyone imagines.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: The bad news just keeps coming. Dan Heng's gone off on his own, and Madam Yao's completely vanished. Can you still sense her?
rows.speaker: Tingyun

rows.text: The bird I entrusted to General Yao Guang has seemingly gone silent. I can't share its vision anymore. I can't even feel her thoughts through it.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: But I know it hasn't faded. That means she's still in this world somewhere.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Let's pray she returns soon, with some news to pierce through all this fog. Otherwise, this arcadia built on happiness will crumble fast and fall into the abyss...
rows.speaker: Tingyun

rows.text: Blurry_QR_Colt... That's an unusual name.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Why would the author of Fluffy Across the Blue have such a pen name?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Maybe the author's eyes went blurry after too much drawing.
He's a Duomension City horse!
You're taking it a bit too literally. But... it's not impossible!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Really? A pen name often says a lot about its creator...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Someone who can draw something that cute must have a warm, gentle heart.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I heard The Fluffy's been running for half a year in a magazine. At first, it wasn't very popular in Planarcadia.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: But after that Memory Bubble movie Holy Grail/stay night Old Oti produced became a massive hit, the Astral Express's adventure stories spread far and wide, and The Fluffy started gaining popularity.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Now the latest chapter, The Sacred Flame's Return: Amphoreus's Creation, is sold out everywhere!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: This Colt sure knows a lot about our journey. Must be a galactic fan of the Express Crew.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Another villain, perhaps?
We just gained another loyal fan!
I still think we deserve royalties though.
Come on, what ever happened to trust?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Yes, yes. You've told us the story of Cinderborne ten times since we got back from Pearluxe Tower.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Royalties? You're being way too opportunistic. It's a comic where we're the protagonists, someone's giving us free publicity! Can't you cut them a little slack?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: According to the address the Pearluxe employee gave us, it looks like we've arrived at a familiar place...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: For such a small place, Dovebrook District is really full of hidden talents.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Turn left at the first intersection, then turn right. Go straight for two hundred meters. Wait, this is...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Silence!
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: My apologies, officers. I can't provide anything useful for now, but rest assured. I'll cooperate with any investigation from the Department of Aberration Defense or the Security Bureau. And of course, I'll fulfill my civic duty...
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: The Furbobo Weekly newspaper!?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Don't tell me the author of The Fluffy is actually a furbo! No wonder he rarely shows his face.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: [Trailblazer], come on, let's go upstairs!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: The Fluffy goes puff-puff-puff, Pom-Pom's fur? Extra fluffy stuff.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: What? A million!? President Nihilux has already been behind on my... I mean, behind on everyone's wages for months! If it weren't for the money... who'd risk their neck being a tabloid journalist, sneaking photos of the bigwigs on the Astral Express?
rows.speaker: Furbulitzer

rows.text: A boss who doesn't pay wages has no right to sit here, they belong in the underworld!
rows.speaker: Furbulitzer

rows.text: Idiots. Without me, you'd all have been locked up in some Department of Aberration Defense painting prison long ago. And you still have the gall to demand wages from your savior?
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: [Trailblazer], have you ever heard of the sensational serial thief case "Phantom Furbomorph"? It happened in the year 1996 of the Arcadian Calendar—
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: I'm sorry! I was wrong! I shouldn't have talked back! I'm sorry for being born a furbo!
rows.speaker: Furbulitzer

rows.text: We've had enough! We've overthrown the boss! We've got a new President now! [Trailblazer], please stand up for us!
rows.speaker: Furbulitzer

rows.text: Welcome, Nameless! Furbo hotpot requires a reservation, rumors are 10,000 credits a piece, and if you're looking to hire a hitman, just head right down the hall to the storeroom. Oh, or maybe—
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: You came to meet the brilliant, charming, and universally adored Blurry_QR_Colt? Well then... truth be told, that person is actually—
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: We should really be charging royalties.
Once you rule out all the wrong answers, only one truth remains—
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: The only one here who can actually draw is you, Nihilux. You're Blurry_QR_Colt!
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Ah, you saw right through me. As a reward for seeing through my disguise, how about an autograph or a photo?
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Allow me to reintroduce myself. I'm Nihilux, you can also call me by my pen name, Blurry_QR_Colt.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: No wonder you were tagging along back at Pearluxe Tower, acting like you knew us so well. Wait...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: This "Blurry_QR_Colt" persona isn't a fake too, is it?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Identity is just a mask and a body. Real or fake, it's all in how you see it.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: At the very least, for now, there's no other Blurry_QR_Colt around who could show up at Star Rail FEST for a live signing and hype up the Astral Express, right?
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: So you already know why we're here?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Just a little deduction, that's all.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Naturally, having me step in was part of her plan.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: If that's the case, will you...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: That's not a signing event, but a public execution, right?
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Yeah, that does sound pretty horrifying.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: So tell me, Miss Nihilux, do you really have the right to refuse us? You've used the Crew's likenesses and adventure experiences without permission... Surely you owe us some form of compensation.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Wh—Why are we talking about this all of a sudden?
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Today, on behalf of the entire Astral Express crew, for your violation of our publicity rights, emotional damages, and lost wages, I hereby demand...
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: 1.6 billion credits!
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: How did you work that out?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Believe it or not, I, uh, don't have a single coin on me right now...
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: That's impossible! Just your royalties alone should've made you rich—
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Due to... uh, "unknown circumstances," my luck with money hasn't been great. But I get what this is really about. You're not only after cash, are you~
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: I'll show up at "Star Rail FEST." Is that good enough for you?
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Then it's settled. Thank you, Colt!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: That said, I also hope the two of you, as the original inspirations, will take some time to familiarize yourselves with Fluffy Across the Blue before attending the exhibition, so you won't be caught off guard by fans' questions.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Time to attend Miss Nihilux's class. Please follow me.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: March, The Fluffy is just a comic. Outside of this, the author and the readers, every character in this world, aren't we all the protagonists of our own lives?
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Ever since I got punched in the face by sales numbers, I've grasped a universal truth: In today's world, fluffy cute animals are always a crowd pleaser.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: And the big brown dog on the other side, see? His name will shock you! That's right, he's—
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Just Mr. Yang.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: In the comic world, which is even more cutthroat than the Phantasmoon Games, if you don't cater to the readers' tastes, it's nearly impossible to survive.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Your heroic deeds and accomplishments drew my attention, and your demeanor gave me inspiration for the character in The Fluffy.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Alright, since we've got the profit split sorted, looks like my creative block won't last much longer. Just wait for my appearance at "Star Rail FEST"!
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: "A Supplicant is the master of Wishpower, but Wishpower can also become the shackles that bind the Supplicant, forcing them to fulfill its desires."
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: "Love and hatred are alike. Dependence resembles fear. What commands Wishpower isn't only love, but also hatred."
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: What's the problem? I'm the magazine's founder, its president, and its editor-in-chief. It's only logical that I'd be sitting here.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Miss Nihilux, why are YOU here?!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Haha, who could it be?
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Thank you... These notes will really be a big help to [Trailblazer].
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Holy furboly! My paws can't even hold a pen. How could I possibly draw comics!?
rows.speaker: Furbulitzer

rows.text: Ugh... Even more nonexistent memories. What are you even talking about!?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Stick to being the Baseball Raccoon okay? I don't need special treatment.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Wow, that's a smug face!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: So every time you land somewhere, you just run around to get more screen time, huh!?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Good. I'm so glad to be of help.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: For generations, many members of our family have attempted to enter the Phantasmoon Games, hoping to rely on the Aeon's immense power to lift the curse afflicting the Graphia bloodline.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: Some came close to the Mask, but could only watch as history passed them by. Others wore it, only to fail in the end.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: That was, until four hundred years ago when your great-great-grandfather, Hiro, won the Phantasmoon Games and successfully gained an audience with Aha.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: A tiny bit.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: If you don't stitch in a few local elements, no one's going to be interested.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: But the family's curse was not broken. In his notes, he wrote—
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: Yes, this is the character, and you're the inspiration behind {M#him.}{F#her.}
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Don't underestimate your influence.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: That must be Oswaldo, right?
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Well said.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: "Just as the God of Destruction cannot cradle a bouquet, so too is the God of Elation powerless against a curse, such is the cycle of cause and effect."
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: Heh, I've already figured out how to spend the royalties. First, I'll buy Pom-Pom ten new outfits, then get Himeko a brand-new coffee machine, and after that...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: What about a thirty-seventy split!?
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Father... are you wondering what it was that healed me?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Could be tomorrow, could be next month, but definitely not today.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: How should I know!? It depends on what trouble you get yourselves into... Uh, I mean, on where you go and on which villain you heroically defeat!
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: I know you're keeping something from me. But I don't care what cured you fifteen years ago. As long as you're alive, I can wait until the day you're ready to tell me.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: After some time, you and March pay a visit to the author of The Fluffy...
Still, as a father, there are things I must say, even if you don't want to hear them.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: As an artist, I'm fascinated by fleeting lives: how they struggle, suffer, and in doing so, reveal a brilliance worthy of time's memory.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: But as a father, I can't stand by and watch my daughter walk into tragedy. "I bless you to be a hero, to welcome the same end as Akivili." Those are words I could never speak.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: The road ahead is shrouded by uncertainty, and that's why someone must take the first step, to trailblaze a path others can follow.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: I can't stop you, even though every part of me wishes you'd stay. But this is your choice, my daughter's choice. All I can do is stand by you quietly and pray you'll come back safely.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: Do you still remember the bedtime story I used to tell?
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: They say there was once a princess in the sky. Day and night, she painted in her celestial garden, untouched by the joys and sorrows of the mortal world.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: One night, a thunderous sound echoed from her painting. Curious, she stepped inside, through seas of flowers, across mountains, until she reached the world's edge.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: There, stood an ancient tower, so tall it pierced the heavens, so vast it seemed to hold the universe itself.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: Climbing the endless staircase, the princess reached the summit, and from there, she saw the world beyond her garden. In the distance, she heard cries, the voices of people, burning in raging fire.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: From that "Tower of Infinity" descended Graphia, to walk the mortal realm. With a single stroke of her brush, she brought forth a thousand imagenae, turning the tide against Destruction.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: To go where there are cries; to go where there are flames. That is the origin of our family name, Murata.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: But beyond the family name, my interpretation of our ancestor's name, "Graphia," is also the hope I place in you.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: Himeko, whatever choice you make... if this is truly what you want, then go, use those steps blazed upon trails to paint the world as you see it.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: Thank you, Dad.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Let me guess... Your next line is—
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: "Why are you here!?"
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Mmm, I won't say anything then.
It's you!
By the way, how's your... health? You haven't picked up any bad habits like smoking or drinking while I was away, have you?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: It finally occurs to you why the name "Nihilux" always felt vaguely familiar. The former president of Furbobo Weekly, that deadbeat boss who skipped town to dodge her debts, went by that exact name.
Hah, as the dean of Graphia Academy, I still have to set a good example for my students. It's just... my tendinitis keeps acting up, my herniated disc is getting worse.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: Himeko, how long will you be staying?
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: At least until the lunar cycle shifts, I'll stay here in Planarcadia until then.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Himeko... safe travels on the trails ahead.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: Beep-boop! Even if you've got dirt on us, making us work for free is way too ridiculous!
rows.speaker: Paraprince

rows.text: Hello everyone, welcome to Fulwish TV's special news segment, Arcadian Morning Report! I'm your host, Poofy!
rows.speaker: Poofy

rows.text: Hi everyone, I'm your host, Snowie!
rows.speaker: Snowie

rows.text: The "Star Rail FEST" exhibition venue, funded by Pearluxe Corp and constructed by Turbogen Heavy Industries, has officially been completed.
rows.speaker: Snowie

rows.text: Thanks to modern imagenesis technology, it took only a day for the skyline's Lookout Cloud to take on a completely new look.
rows.speaker: Poofy

rows.text: Furbulitzer? You!?
March, are you moonlighting as a comic artist behind my back?
Cut it out.
Starting today, the Lookout Cloud Line is officially opening up a stop for the Star Rail FEST exhibition areas.
rows.speaker: Snowie

rows.text: The exhibition areas opening on day one include the Belobog Area, Xianzhou Luofu Area, and Penacony Area, showcasing the legendary adventures of the Astral Express. The Amphoreus Area, which is currently under construction, will open in due course.
rows.speaker: Snowie

rows.text: For this event, Pearluxe cordially invites several crew members of the Astral Express to visit and be interviewed, including [Trailblazer], who recently joined the Phantasmoon Games as a Supplicant.
rows.speaker: Poofy

rows.text: That is certainly something to look forward to! I heard Pearluxe has also invited Blurry_QR_Colt, the author of Fluffy Across the Blue, for a signing session. It'll be the first time the author reveals their true face in public...
rows.speaker: Snowie

rows.text: The exhibition areas now open will transport you straight into the Astral Express's incredible journey across the sea of stars! And right now, ladies and gentlemen, you're standing in none other than... Belobog!
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Now, let me hear you call out the name of our hero from the ice and snow!
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Come on! Come on! You've got this, Madam Cocolia!
rows.speaker: Live Spectators

rows.text: When I grow up, I wanna be the Supreme Guardian and turn into a Frost Giant to fight those rampaging Super Ancient Weapons!
rows.speaker: Naive Child

rows.text: In my next life, I wanna be the Supreme Guardian and turn into a magical girl to protect Planarcadia.
rows.speaker: Naive Adult

rows.text: Wait, this isn't right... Why is everyone supporting... Cocolia?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Why is Sparxie the host!?
We meet again, [Trailblazer].
rows.speaker: Blazeweaver

rows.text: What's wrong with having the most popular streamer girl host the biggest event?
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: W—W—Wait, aren't you supposed to be on the Department of Aberration Defense's wanted list?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: This is Star Rail FEST... Even if you defeat me, you'll never gain everyone's approval.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: I thought the outcome of our clash at Pearluxe Tower was pretty clear.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: That's right... So I'll have to go into hiding right after this job. Come to think of it, maybe I should lie low using my Sparkle identity. After all, what does Sparkle have to do with this Sparxie they're after?
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Oh right, Nameless, won't you take pity on me and give me back my mask...
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: In your dreams!
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer] & March 7th

rows.text: Yoohoo! Since we have two Nameless from the Astral Express here with us today, let's kick off an exciting The Fluffy trivia quiz!
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Here's your question: In the final chapter of The Fluffy's Belobog arc, "The Supreme Guardian's Bond," what did Cocolia summon to fight by her side?
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: The Guardian Wand that could transform her into an Ice Giant!
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Well, well, looks like this young lady here is quite the devoted reader of The Fluffy, answering even faster than the Nameless!
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Shouldn't it be the Engine of Creation?
What's wrong? Can't a pretty girl have her own special effects?
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: You're quite the romantic, aren't you?
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: I know you're never serious about anything, so I guess I'll just have to answer my own question.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: It was clearly the Lance of the Eternal Freeze.
Hey, why are you stealing my thunder?
Sorry, I'm just being overprotective.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Oh right, I almost forgot she was the one who first awakened the Engine of Creation.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Those two huge chunks of ice were definitely quite impressive.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I'm a die-hard fan of The Fluffy, you know!
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: I'm not giving the mask back to you. Get over it!
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: And what's the deal with this Ice Giant? Sure, Cocolia can transform, but she shouldn't be anywhere near the size of the Engine of Creation!
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: How could I? As a famous streamer, poor little Sparxicle has always been troubled by constant cyberbullying~
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: What? Lady Cocolia fought the Engine of Creation in her human form? That... That just makes it even more awesome! Ugh, but they didn't show that part in the comic!
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Next question: Before Cocolia was frozen in ice, what did she give to Baseball Raccoon?
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: The flaming lance! In the end, the little raccoon used that lance to channel everyone's light to Cocolia, restoring her power so she could descend in her Wildfire form!
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: ... Every time I turn to that page, I can't help but burst into tears.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: ...Indeed, every word came from my mouth. But when pieced together, it turned into a declaration of war.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Actually, I inherited this flaming lance from the previous Supreme Guardians when I got stabbed right through the heart.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Sorry, got a bit... held up on the way. Since I entered the exhibition area, at least seven folks stopped me asking for the autograph of this guy called Welt.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: What are you talking about, [Trailblazer]...
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: So, The Fluffy's storyline follows the official Belobogian narrative.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Wait... is that not how things went? Could you at least spill a little? Just a little?
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Don't be so paranoid.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: I still remember that moment when I faced the Doomsday Beast on the space station...
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: I'm afraid of losing my companions... afraid of death... There are so many things that I fear.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: ...I see. If the truth about this were to be revealed to the people of Belobog, the hard-earned peace would crumble, wouldn't it?
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: ...Nescia, please keep this a secret!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Of course, my lips are sealed!
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: But I have to say, I'm surprised that even the heroes of the Astral Express can tell lies.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: They say lies don't last forever, and while Belobog's future may be built on a lie, I hope it can endure for a long, long time.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Because those people are all my friends.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Thank you for telling me about this.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: The Phantasmoon Games make Supplicants wear masks, but if you ask me? That's when people really drop the act and face their true selves.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: [Trailblazer], the event's not over yet! Come join me on the stage and deliver your decisive strike in the epic battle between Madam Cocolia and the Destruction Engine!
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Madam Cocolia is in crisis! Hang in there, Madam Cocolia!
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Fear not, everyone! I can see our hero approaching!
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Well, that is Pearluxe's forte.
This arrangement works out well for both parties.
When I talked with Pearl, I shared with her the idea of becoming a sail, advancing and retreating together. This collaboration could truly bring out the best of our respective strengths.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Today, we are honored to welcome to Star Rail FEST the hero of the Astral Express, one who survived the Battle of Belobog, [Trailblazer]!
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Let me hear you say the name of the will of Preservation's successor!
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: [Trailblazer]! [Trailblazer]! [Trailblazer]!
rows.speaker: Joyful Spectators

rows.text: Come on, warrior from beyond the sky! Show us that legendary scene again!
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Ignite your flaming lance, charge up Madam Cocolia with your power, and let her hear our calls!
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: The host is calling for you. Time to take the stage, great hero.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Reenacting a legendary scene right here, haha... Good thing I'm not the one up there. [Trailblazer], you're gonna shout that line when you ignite it, right?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Of course it's "flaming lance, forward"! You've gotta shout it really loud!
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Little raccoon, aren't you going to go up there? The audience is getting anxious.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Nameless~ Where's our Nameless? Let's all give [Trailblazer] another huge round of applause and welcome them to the stage!
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: What's wrong, Nescia?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: ...I'm getting all emotional. This scene takes me back to the moment I first cracked open the Fluffy Across the Blue comics.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: The speeding Express, dazzling cosmos, and a bunch of quirky yet adventurous companions...
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: I know the "story" is fiction, but I really wanna be part of it and travel with you guys.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: But... leaving home? That's not exactly easy for me...
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Tis I, Cold Dragon Young... Dan Heng!
rows.speaker: Masked Person

rows.text: Thanks for the love. And hey, traveling with the little animals aboard The Fluffy still counts as traveling with us in my book!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Being able to connect with friends like you through stories is probably the most precious part of this journey.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Well said! Shall we head to the next exhibition area then?
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Alright, let's get moving!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: [Trailblazer], look! Isn't that Miss Serval?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: What brings you here?
Even our friends from Belobog made it here!
Miss Topaz extended an invitation to Belobog, hoping we could visit Planarcadia to discuss a cultural exchange program.
rows.speaker: Serval

rows.text: I couldn't help but wonder if this was another blessing from the Astral Express... And sure enough, that's exactly what it was.
rows.speaker: Serval

rows.text: How's everything in Belobog?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Great! Everything's great! The ice is melting way faster than we expected. Lynxy told me that more frozen cities are gradually being uncovered. And it's all thanks to you guys!
rows.speaker: Serval

rows.text: A cultural exchange program?
For other people, cultural exchange means showcasing products from Jarilo, whereas for me, it's all about rock 'n' roll.
rows.speaker: Serval

rows.text: This place is way livelier than I imagined, and the rock music here has given me so much creative inspiration!
rows.speaker: Serval

rows.text: [Trailblazer], it's all thanks to you guys for lighting that spark back then. Now, it's our turn to carry the torch forward, Belobog style! Like, with some mind-blowing rock 'n' roll!
rows.speaker: Serval

rows.text: You must be pretty busy! After all, a whole exhibition is being held for the Astral Express. I won't take up more of your time. Let's chat later when you're free.
rows.speaker: Serval

rows.text: Welcome aboard The Fluffy Shuttle Express! Are you ready to head to our next stop, the Xianzhou Luofu Exhibition Area?
rows.speaker: Shuttle

rows.text: I have to say, Pearluxe really put care into organizing this exhibition.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I wonder what attractions await us in the Xianzhou Luofu Exhibition Area?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Brr—brr, the frigid waters of Scalegorge Waterscape are chilling me to the bone!
rows.speaker: Aisle Spectator

rows.text: Why is there so much water in the exhibition area? Did a pipe burst or something?
rows.speaker: Aisle Spectator

rows.text: I bet this is some cutting-edge immersive theater performance. I gotta say, these tickets are totally worth every penny...
rows.speaker: Aisle Spectator

rows.text: Looks like there's some trouble brewing in the Xianzhou Exhibition Area.
Based on what we saw in the Belobog area, The Fluffy's adventure on the Xianzhou should be...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I got it! It must be {RUBY_B#Dan Heng}Woof Woof Dan{RUBY_E#} teaming up with {RUBY_B#Jing Yuan}Jing Yuanyuan{RUBY_E#} to battle against Lord Ravager Phanty!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: When people talk about the Astral Express's most memorable moment in the Xianzhou War, it can only be— the epic fight! The triumphant return of the High-Cloud Squadron!
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: When people say "squadron" they mean a bunch of superheroes teaming up.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Did I... get too excited? Sorry, sorry, I really got carried away.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Not at all, haha. I'm guessing this "High-Cloud Squadron" must be referring to Xianzhou's "High-Cloud Quintet," right?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: D-Did a Memosnatcher steal my memories? When we fought Phantylia, did we really have that many people helping us? Five at once?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I can't take it anymore! I'm bursting with curiosity! Quick, let's go inside and take a look!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Your gaze falls upon the table, and in an instant, the shocking words sear themselves into your widening eyes.
"If any of you happen to be super hackers, space warriors, spirit whisperers, or those cursed by Aeons, come find me. I've said my piece."
"Looking for a sense of truth in fictional stories is just human nature!"
"Rubert II, wise throughout the universe, profound in his insights, was bestowed the title 'Profound One' by Nous."
"If it pleases you, my king, we shall storm the throne and snatch that bloody seat from Rubert I!"
"Among the countless stars are whispered the secret chronicles of Rubert."
"Our destiny lies only among the sea of stars!"
"On June 1st, year 40,000 of the Trailblaze Empire Era, at 2:55 AM, Watt Yang's life came to an end at the age of thirty-three."
"Three minutes later, he sat up again."
A fun little tale about the cosmos's most wanted criminals forming a family and going on all sorts of missions. They even kept a cat that grinds video games for them... by the name of Silver Wolf.
"I'm sorry, Kafka. You can survive without me. But if I leave Mr. Yang, he won't make it."
"What about Silver Wolf... Are you planning to release her back into the wild?"
Forget it, looking through these things is making me hear things.
Holy moly, they nailed the Scalegorge Waterscape! The whole exhibition area is completely submerged!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Little raccoon, little raccoon, I wanna see that thing!
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: That thing?
Which one?
Rending my form~
March, you're interested in this?
Rending... my form... setting free... a thunderous roar, a symphony...
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Hi, [Trailblazer]! Sorry to bother you! We're with Fulwish TV! It's our lucky day running into you here! Do you have a moment?
rows.speaker: Reporter

rows.text: Hold it right there! Please do me a favor and stop that!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Nescia means that thing! With a flick of the hand, the ancient sea splits apart!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Sure thing.
First question: Seeing as Planarcadia was the starting point of the Express's new voyage, how would you describe your impressions of this place?
rows.speaker: Reporter

rows.text: Woof Woof Dan, I've actually been a huge fan of yours all along. From the very first page of Volume 1, Chapter 1, I was already captivated by you.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Interesting. Throughout the history of the Phantasmoon Games, it's been extremely rare to have such a renowned cosmic figure as yourself participating. As the Astral Express's Supplicant, what kind of changes do you hope to bring to this world in these Games?
rows.speaker: Reporter

rows.text: ...Who on earth did this kid learn to ask favors like that from?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: That's an impressive answer! Speaking of which, after joining the games, you immediately went to defeat Miss Sparxie, who represented the Masked Fools. What are your thoughts on potentially facing native Supplicants in the future?
rows.speaker: Reporter

rows.text: From March Bunny in the comic, if you must know!
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Speaking of local Supplicants, we've noticed that "Star Rail FEST" is Pearluxe Corp's way of rolling out the red carpet for the Express. There are rumors that the IPC is also sponsoring the Express. So, I have to ask: Are you representing the Express or the IPC in these Games?
rows.speaker: Reporter

rows.text: At the end of the day, this is a festival for everyone, and I'm just one of the guests. I'm not the master of this place.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: It's the media alright... Those hard-hitting questions had you sweating bullets. You burned through every ounce of corporate speak you'll ever have in this lifetime.
Every micro-expression on your face is screaming: End this interview already!
...What!? This... is... absolutely... the biggest personal attack on me ever!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Never mind, I'll go ask someone about what's going on.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Hey host, this immersive theater is getting a bit TOO immersive, don't you think?
rows.speaker: Waiting Spectator

rows.text: It's been almost twenty minutes. Where is the actor who's going to split the sea?
rows.speaker: Waiting Spectator

rows.text: That's right! The script for this exhibition's stage play was written under the guidance of the Xianzhou's legendary literary master, Mr. Xiyan! We guarantee you'll get an authentic re-creation of the Express's most iconic moments!
rows.speaker: Hostess

rows.text: Sure, mind telling me if it's free?
Hard to say no to that, right?
This serial number seems a bit much...
It's you! [Trailblazer]! I don't know what happened, but water just started gushing out everywhere!
rows.speaker: Hostess

rows.text: Please! Save this exhibition area like you saved Scalegorge Waterscape before!
rows.speaker: Hostess

rows.text: Alright then.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Welcome, dear visitors and spectators! At this moment, you've arrived along with the Astral Express at the ancient and mysterious... Xianzhou!
rows.speaker: Hostess

rows.text: It's the Xianzhou Luofu!
rows.speaker: Serious Spectator

rows.text: Good thing I'm built tough.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Evanescia, you just won't stop haunting me, huh?
I'm really sorry!
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Why are you here?
That's got to be the lamest excuse I've ever heard!
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: That trope is so outdated...
What's your real motive for getting close to me?

It suddenly hits you... This girl in front of you is the one who gave you the chance to turn the tables in your first battle of the Supplicants. Whatever her reasons for approaching you, she clearly doesn't mean you any harm.
I'm more than happy to befriend those who are destined to be part of these games, as long as they can show me their "wish."
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: How were you able to draw the mask?
If you call those lousy doodles you made when drawing the mask "talent"...
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: And now, it's showtime! Adapted from the true adventures of the Astral Express, we present: Battle at Scalegorge Waterscape! High-Cloud Squadron Assembles!
rows.speaker: Hostess

rows.text: Thanks to the support of Fulwish TV, we invited the four main stars of the action hero series Daybreak Squadron to perform in this show!
rows.speaker: Hostess

rows.text: And now, [Trailblazer], please come up on stage and reenact that heart-stopping battle where you drove away the Lord Ravager!
rows.speaker: Hostess

rows.text: What do you want?
At this very moment, two voices appear on either side of you. They tell you—
I don't think that's necessary.
rows.speaker: Azurewing

rows.text: Aren't we supposed to be the "heroes of the Xianzhou"? Why do the Xianzhou's heroes need to rely on others to save their land?
rows.speaker: Dawnlance

rows.text: Same as us! Shouldn't the heroes of this world be able to protect our own people? Can't we be the ones to bring happy smiles to their faces?
rows.speaker: Blazeweaver

rows.text: Hey, what nonsense are you all babbling about? Is any of this actually in the script?
rows.speaker: Hostess

rows.text: No, quite the opposite. Star Rail FEST is the perfect opportunity...
rows.speaker: Blazeweaver

rows.text: As Supplicants stepping into the Phantasmoon Games, the Daybreak Squadron challenges you! You wouldn't back down now, would you, Supplicant of the Astral Express?
rows.speaker: Blazeweaver

rows.text: What!? ...This is so unexpected! ...These tickets were totally worth it! ...To think the Daybreak Squadron were Supplicants too!
rows.speaker: Audience

rows.text: What!? This is waaaay too sudden!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: These people... Something's not right about them.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: I feel like... they're way too hyped up. Even characters in action comics don't talk like this...
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Yeah, in comics, a challenge like this is always a cover for some massive conspiracy... I... I've gotta fight alongside [Trailblazer]!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: March, you need to have faith in [Trailblazer]'s abilities. Rather than rushing into battle, what you should be doing now is getting in touch with your companions...
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: ...Boss, do we really have to do this?
rows.speaker: Cinderborne

rows.text: Gray, we've been putting on a show for long enough. Wasn't becoming a real hero what you've always wanted!?
rows.speaker: Blazeweaver

rows.text: We'll tear the legend of this outsider to shreds, right here under the spotlight! Then everyone will see who the real heroes are, the ones who can truly protect their smiles!
rows.speaker: Blazeweaver

rows.text: I accept your challenge, but do we really have to fight here?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Hey, are you recycling your lines?
You've just met, and you're besties already!?
This is exactly the stage we've been waiting for! Let's do this!
rows.speaker: Blazeweaver

rows.text: ...Have you calmed down now? Can we talk?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Once a Supplicant's challenge begins, it won't stop until one side falls.
rows.speaker: Blazeweaver

rows.text: Don't get it wrong. This is just a prelude to the real showdown, witnessed by the Phantasmoon!
rows.speaker: Blazeweaver

rows.text: Have you considered the possibility that they might be the real deal? And how inappropriate it is to ask our distinguished guests for tickets?
rows.speaker: Agent Feld

rows.text: Hello there, we meet again! HQ arranged for me to wait here and welcome all of you. Miss Himeko has already entered the venue. {M#Mr.}{F#Miss.} [Trailblazer], Miss March 7th, and this is...?
rows.speaker: Agent Feld

rows.text: Just what exactly are they planning to do here at Star Rail FEST?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: She's our friend.
Our new pet aboard the Express.
She's just kidding. This is our good friend.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: What are you talking about? It's just the two of us here.
Huh!? You can see her too, right?
rows.speaker: Agent Feld

rows.text: They're just messing with you! She is a friend of ours. Is it possible for you to make an exception just this once...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Heh, you folks sure have a great sense of humor.
rows.speaker: Agent Feld

rows.text: Is this the Supplicant lurking beneath the surface that Pearl theorized about?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: But which of the four Daybreak Warriors is the Supplicant? Judging from their strength, I think it might be the red one...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Forget it! We should go check out what's happening outside the exhibition area!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Interrupting a show for no reason. But to be honest, I wasn't dying to watch that "High-Cloud Squadron Assembles" play anyway.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: So... don't tell me this whole Xianzhou story is also something Blurry made up...?
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Funny, can't say I'm surprised at all.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: I wouldn't dare take credit for what I didn't do, since it was in fact General Jing Yuan and Dan Heng who teamed up to defeat Phantylia.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Actually, I've never read the comics...
As for the High-Cloud Quintet, it's been over seven hundred years since those five made their mark.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Ding ding, that's correct!
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: I know it may sound wild, but Xianzhou folks generally live really long lives. You've read The Fluffy comics, haven't you? Pretty sure they covered all that lore in there.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Yeah, immortality... Some see it as a curse. But personally, I don't think the Abundance is as terrifying as THEIR reputation suggests.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: I almost forgot we're not in the Xianzhou anymore... Should be fine to talk openly about the Abundance now, I guess?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Yeah, that's not an issue. But the Xianzhou's attitude towards the Abundance isn't totally baseless. We've clashed with the borisin, fought against the mara-struck...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Actually, I think the Abundance and Elation make quite a good match.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: After all, only with infinite life can one pursue infinite joy.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Nothing at all.
In my opinion, those who are alive have the right to choose death. But they also have the right to choose to live on.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Ding ding, that's correct!
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: After all, there's always something out there that makes tomorrow worth waking up to.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Wow, getting all philosophical on me now. When this kid gets serious like that, I swear you can practically see the wrinkles forming...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: In Belobog's final battle, wasn't it like this: Despite her grievous wounds, the Supreme Guardian transformed herself into a Frost Giant for the sake of the people of the winter-lands, joining forces with the Nameless to counter the Destruction Engine that was about to flatten Belobog!
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Uhh...
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer] & March 7th

rows.text: Hehe! Since we're talking about waking up, shouldn't we head over to the Penacony Exhibition Area next?
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Huh, you want to keep exploring? We need to be a bit more careful now, don't you think? I mean, the Daybreak Squadron already came gunning for us. Who knows if there are other Supplicants lurking around, just waiting to make their move?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Sorry, I can't say too much.
Then that means, in reverse, Cocolia was the enemy you defeated?
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Oh come on, March, don't be such a worrywart! Didn't our little raccoon take out those guys in no time at all?
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Rest assured, I've got your back!
Such reassuring words! Little raccoon, I've actually been a huge fan of yours all along...
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Sorry about that. Pretty disenchanting, isn't it?
Alright, alright, don't push it.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Here we come, Penacony!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: ... Exhibition Area!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Himeko! You're here!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: March, [Trailblazer], are you alright? Welt told me to watch the livestream, and I saw the Daybreak Squadron challenging [Trailblazer].
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: You did well. I bet their intention was to stir up their supporters' Wishpower through the challenge.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: If you'd hurt them recklessly, it might've pushed many supporters straight into their arms.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Oh, and you are...
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Nice to see you again! Express Navigator, Miss Himeko!
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Pardon my poor memory, but have we met before?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Of course! ...I've seen you in the news more than once! It's such an honor to meet you!
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: This is Evanescia. I think she's a student from Graphia Academy? [Trailblazer] and I ran into her at this expo, and she's a huge fan of both The Fluffy and the Express!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: She's the one who drew my mask.
Darn it, I wanna pilot the Engine of Creation!
I don't feel like doing this. Have March do it!
Let's do this!
So that girl you saw in the Phantasmoon Courtyard... It was her?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Flaming lance! Forward!
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: The spear tip has been ignited! Kids and grown-ups alike, raise your glow-sticks high, and let's show our support for Cocolia, shall we?
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: You've got this, Madam Cocolia!
rows.speaker: Ardent Spectator

rows.text: Hahaha, seeing everyone so fired up makes me want to join in on the cheering too!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: You've got this, Madam Cocolia!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Don't give up, Madam Cocolia!
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: W—Wait a second... She made you a mask? So you're telling me Nescia isn't just a normal girl?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Who exactly is she?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Who exactly are you?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Me? I'm no different from you, just a spectator of the Phantasmoon Games. Though I suppose my position is a bit... special.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: I had so much fun tagging along with you two. Who would've thought that The Fluffy had such an interesting backstory?
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: I think it's time to say goodbye for now!
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Our story is that very light.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Are you leaving, Miss Evanescia?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Now that my identity has been exposed, Cinderella's magic is about to wear off. And since this little adventure started on a whim, might as well end it on one too~
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Little raccoon, you can feel it, can't you? All that attention, all that joy from the exhibition. As you fulfill people's "wishes," that power has been flowing straight into your mask.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: It might spark something beautiful, or plant the seeds of something sinister. Whatever you choose, I just hope you won't become a boring character.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Ah, I'm rambling again, aren't I...?
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Well then... Before I go, let me break this awkward moment with a riddle: Do you know why flowers are so beautiful?
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Because flowers are always so fleeting.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Ah...
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: You left your own special effects behind...
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: She's gone.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Even the villain's name is so cute!
Unexpected people and unexpected things always make an appearance in the Phantasmoon Games... Although Miss Evanescia claims to be just a spectator...
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: What's the High-Cloud Squadron...
As someone who can create masks and allow others to become Supplicants... there's no way she's just some ordinary girl.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: I just don't know what to make of everything happening to [Trailblazer].
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Alright, time for us to head out.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: These people will dream up anything!
Where to?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Let's continue forward, to the next stop: the Penacony Exhibition Area.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: I have a feeling that the Daybreak Squadron's challenge isn't over yet. As the stars of this exhibition, if you left just to avoid conflict, all the spectators might think you chickened out and fled.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Darn it, this whole Daybreak Squadron business has got me on edge. Somehow I can't shake the feeling we're being watched.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Here's some good news: At least [Trailblazer] isn't completely without help. Pearl's people are on their way to the Penacony Exhibition Area to join up with us.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: I can't do cloudhymn!
Flattery will get you nowhere!
Would I get run over by the Express if I lay down on the tracks?
rows.speaker: Fervent Spectator

rows.text: Yep, and you'd get blasted straight into a comic book! Who knows, maybe you'll be reborn as some superhero or something!
rows.speaker: Dreamy Spectator

rows.text: That's what I'd call true happiness.
rows.speaker: Grinning Spectator

rows.text: ...It's hard to believe they recreated the scene where the Express crashes into The Great Septimus!
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: All the previous exhibitions were so hilarious, but they really nailed The Great Septimus part.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Like they say: Once you turn to the dark side, you get triple the power.
It's just a burst pipe, isn't it?
I was thinking of inviting Sunny over here.
What's that supposed to mean? You taking a jab at me?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: That's just mean!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: That's right, the Xianzhou Luofu's Scalegorge Waterscape! Let's give thanks to [Trailblazer], hero of the Astral Express, who not only saved the Xianzhou Luofu but also happened to save our little venue today!
rows.speaker: Hostess

rows.text: So, where's the person Pearl sent?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Huh? Who's calling?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Yoohoo~ How ya doing, Gray Hair?
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Daybreak Squadron again?
Why are you still dressed like that?
I heard about your big fight with the superheroes. And since I actually respect you as a rival, I thought I'd give you a heads-up.
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: You might think you scored a massive win in the Phantasmoon Games, but most people probably don't see it that way.
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Anyway, the news is on right now. Why don't you go check it out?
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Just moments ago! An extremely violent incident broke out at the ongoing "Star Rail FEST" exhibition venue!
rows.speaker: Poofy

rows.text: If you're planning to challenge me...
The Astral Express Supplicant [Trailblazer] brazenly launched a brutal attack on the beloved local heroes, the Daybreak Squadron! The scene descended into total chaos!
rows.speaker: Poofy

rows.text: Oh my! This is terrifying! Didn't this Nameless just defeat Sparxie and save Graphia Academy?
rows.speaker: Snowie

rows.text: Fulwish TV will continue to follow this shocking incident! Stay tuned and don't go away!
rows.speaker: Poofy

rows.text: Haha, it's all over the internet now~
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Some say you're a violent maniac, others think you're behind the bloodbath in Dovebrook, that you're the second Herald of Death.
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Oopsie, how are you feeling right about now, hmmm?
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Of course, someone's definitely pulling strings behind the scenes and stirring up drama. As a top streamer in this field, Sparxicle can spot these tricks from a mile away!
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Oh right, didn't you also do a TV news interview?
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: I didn't say anything in particular, did I?
Are you talking about...?
It's not about what you said... It's that you said it.
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Yoohoo, you bet!
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Here, let me send you the interview video!
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: I won't go any further, but since you managed to defeat Miss Sparkle... no, I mean Miss Sparxie, I don't want to see you embarrass yourself in front of those clowns.
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: That was quite entertaining.
Good luck, see you around!
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Keep it brief, I've got plans later.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Planarcadia... Everyone's chasing the latest trends, looking for fun.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Show everyone the strength of the Trailblaze, to change this world!
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: The other native Supplicants... way too dangerous. I'd rather defeat them through violence.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: At the end of the day, this is a festival for the IPC's interests. Madam Pearl and Pearluxe extended such a warm invitation. I'm not one of the guests. I'm the master of this place.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: W—Wait, what!? This... This is a totally malicious edit to frame [Trailblazer]! How shameless!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Over these fifteen years, the nature of competition in the Phantasmoon Games has evolved. The Daybreak Squadron's taunts were just smoke and mirrors. The real game is being played in the shadows, where our opponents have mastered the art of weaponizing public opinion.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Come to think of it, it's only natural. After all, the true stars of the Games were never the Supplicants on stage... but rather the audience whose gazes they command.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Ah, just imagine if we hadn't won that battle against Phantylia back then, the universe would've ended up with an immortal, indestructible Lord Ravager!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Indeed, the audience is all fired up, waiting to see you work your magic, [Trailblazer]...
But you know what~ I bet what they really want to see deep down is the Daybreak Squadron taking the Astral Express down a peg or two.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Well, well, if it isn't the folks from the Astral Express. Fancy meeting you again.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: This storm online... is several times more intense than the day you stopped SparxiCon.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: Miss Kuchiba! You've seen all this fake news too, right?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Pearl assigned us to investigate the Synwish Syndicate massacre... but every suspicious thread we followed led us from the Research Society of Happy Smiles straight to... the Daybreak Squadron.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: And then there's the one pulling the strings behind the scenes: Fulwish.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Fulwish...?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Oh? You know that name? Now this is getting interesting.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: She was my junior at school. Fifteen years ago, she was also the only student who survived at Graphia Academy.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: The good news is, your junior is living better than anyone else. She owns TV stations, charity organizations, has a huge business empire, and wields both wealth and power.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: As for the bad news... She's probably plotting something for the Phantasmoon Games, and I mean the worst kind of something. My gut tells me that the Synwish Syndicate massacre... well, that's probably on her tab too.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Madam Pearl sent Mr. Ashveil to ensure everyone's safety... Of course, I understand that with the Nameless' skills, there's no real need for extra protection. But Madam Pearl didn't want to take any chances.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: Long story short, feel free to use me as muscle. No need to be shy about it.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: I didn't hurt them.
I'm counting on you then.
So, are we still heading to the top of Pom-Pom tower?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: We should keep moving forward. If my guess is right, the Daybreak Squadron will launch their second attack there.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: Forget about any fantasies of fairness and harmony. From this moment on, the Phantasmoon Games could follow in the footsteps of what happened fifteen years ago...
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Once this battle turns bloody, fear will seep through the screen and become some Supplicant's Wishpower...
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: See, that's the problem with modern society. Good news stays home while bad news spreads like wildfire.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Daybreak Squadron... I thought they were fans of the Express too, but in the blink of an eye, we somehow became enemies.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: They might not be the real enemy here. Someone could be pulling their strings from the shadows.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: If possible, I'd rather persuade them to back down, since once a battle starts, it'll be like pouring fuel into a fire, stoking the audience's bloodlust...
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: A Phantasmoon Game like that would only descend into madness. And I certainly do not want to see what happened fifteen years ago repeat itself on these lands.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: I have no clue.
Oh, I know about this exhibition area! Thanks to the comic Miss March gave me.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Huh, wouldn't have pegged you for a comic book reader.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: I flipped through it on my way to pay respects to Caustide. Even though that volume's story was pretty random and all over the place, it was quite interesting.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: A group of furry animals took over the SoulGlad soda factory to wake up the other animals in Penacony...
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Using SoulGlad as fuel for the Express... Talk about forced product placement.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Time to get to work, detective.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: Look, the Express people are here!
rows.speaker: Audience

rows.text: Quick, stay back! It'd be terrible if you got caught in the crossfire.
rows.speaker: Audience

rows.text: Astral Express, we've been waiting for you for quite a while!
rows.speaker: Blazeweaver

rows.text: I know you're never serious about anything, so I guess I'll just have to answer my own question.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: But I have to say, wrong~ answer~
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: The Astral Express, just as I thought you weren't going to show up. Oh, you brought... help?
rows.speaker: Blazeweaver

rows.text: And it's an old friend... Been a while, old man.
rows.speaker: Blazeweaver

rows.text: People who have lived in Dovebrook share a special connection. Since you're treating me as an old friend, I don't want to act like some high-and-mighty adult telling you what you should and shouldn't do.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: I'll only tell you this: What you're doing right now has already crossed a dangerous line... Whatever orders Fulwish gave you, there's still time to turn back if you stop now.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Wilhelm, Theana, Lucius...
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: And you, Magnus. After my heartfelt warning, do you still insist on taking Fulwish's side?
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Mom, I promise she won't lead me astray.
Th—They're my partners!
rows.speaker: Cinderborne

rows.text: Listen up, old man! Supplicants' challenges during the Phantasmoon Games have no restrictions. That means you have no right to stop us...
rows.speaker: Blazeweaver

rows.text: Like... the Herald of Death?
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: We're not the Herald of Death, and we're definitely not here for bloodshed this time!
rows.speaker: Blazeweaver

rows.text: We will prove to the people that we are true heroes who can protect their happiness!
rows.speaker: Azurewing

rows.text: The Astral Express... These visitors from beyond the sky claim they saved the cosmos from a Lord Ravager... but who knows what the truth really is?
rows.speaker: Blazeweaver

rows.text: This so-called "saving the cosmos" might just be another scheme of the IPC... Just like us back then, putting on a show on TV, desperately trying to comfort the kids in front of the screen...
rows.speaker: Blazeweaver

rows.text: Captain...
rows.speaker: Cinderborne

rows.text: But where were the Nameless of the Astral Express when we children needed protection fifteen years ago!?
rows.speaker: Blazeweaver

rows.text: Gray, don't be fooled by these flashy cosmic heroes!
rows.speaker: Blazeweaver

rows.text: The Astral Express doesn't care about our happiness at all. They come and go like all tourists... No! They're even more heartless than tourists! Because they're here to trample on the Elation's ceremony and steal the arcadian people's attention!
rows.speaker: Blazeweaver

rows.text: They replaced our fantasies of heroes with their own image, all to satisfy their vanity called "the Trailblazing spirit"!
rows.speaker: Blazeweaver

rows.text: Tell me, [Trailblazer], have you ever, even for a moment, felt what it's like to tremble on blood-soaked ground at dusk...
rows.speaker: Blazeweaver

rows.text: It's not the Astral Express you hate. You're just hating yourself... that powerless child who couldn't protect everyone. But I want to tell you, being powerless was never your fault.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Not giving back the mask!
The Astral Express is the GOAT! The Astral Express is number one in the universe!
rows.speaker: Live Spectator

rows.text: Quit yapping! Tear 'em to shreds! Beat 'em to a pulp! I want a bloodbath!
rows.speaker: Live Spectator

rows.text: Daybreak Squadron, beat these alien punks to the ground!
rows.speaker: Live Spectator

rows.text: Shut up! All of you, shut up! As a kid, it wasn't my fault that I was powerless. But we... the orphans of the Bloodstained Games won't remain that way forever.
rows.speaker: Blazeweaver

rows.text: We've... undergone the Happiness Surgery transformation. We've overcome our weak former selves and become Daybreak Warriors! We've grown stronger!
rows.speaker: Blazeweaver

rows.text: Was that victory still not enough? Could {M#he,}{F#she,} like the defeated Sparxie, now be a threat to everyone's safety?
rows.speaker: Snowie

rows.text: How chilling! In the video footage from the scene, [Trailblazer] claimed {M#his}{F#her} act was to demonstrate the so-called "Trailblazing Spirit" of the Astral Express to this world!
rows.speaker: Poofy

rows.text: You don't stand a chance against me.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Is this what {M#he}{F#she} calls "the Trailblaze"? Using brute force and violence to strike down the guardians of this arcadia and trample over our own heroes?
rows.speaker: Snowie

rows.text: Was it... a sudden violent outburst? Or was this the moment {F#her}{M#his} true heartless nature finally came to light?
rows.speaker: Snowie

rows.text: Strange... Even though our suffering was erased, why was I so scared just now? And why were there tears?
rows.speaker: Blazeweaver

rows.text: Brother, that's only because... this pain has been here all along! It's time to overcome it! It's time to use the power of happiness to defeat it once and for all!
rows.speaker: Azurewing

rows.text: Well said. Then let's finish what needs to be done...
rows.speaker: Blazeweaver

rows.text: Let's reclaim from these outsiders the image of heroes that the people of Ahatopia hold dear!
rows.speaker: Blazeweaver

rows.text: Go ahead and laugh all you want.
And then there was some Nameless from the Astral Express who gave me quite the beating IRL~
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: ...What about you, Magnus?
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Sorry, Mr. Ashveil, but a hero never betrays his companions!
rows.speaker: Cinderborne

rows.text: We are the Daybreak Squadron, four warriors of one heart, united to protect the world. I won't let down my companions or those who believe in us.
rows.speaker: Cinderborne

rows.text: We are the true heroes. Look at this statue of the conductor, it's just an empty shell. Even Pearluxe Corp, with countless resources at their disposal, can't breathe life into it.
rows.speaker: Blazeweaver

rows.text: But we can. Let me prove it to you...
rows.speaker: Blazeweaver
