rows.text: Hi, [Trailblazer]! Sorry to bother you! We're with Fulwish TV! It's our lucky day running into you here! Do you have a moment?
rows.speaker: Reporter

rows.text: Stop them! Don't let them drag the Astral Express's name through the mud!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: First question: Seeing as Planarcadia was the starting point of the Express's new voyage, how would you describe your impressions of this place?
rows.speaker: Reporter

rows.text: I shall provide the Wishpower to awaken it.
rows.speaker: Cinderborne

rows.text: Interesting. Throughout the history of the Phantasmoon Games, it's been extremely rare to have such a renowned cosmic figure as yourself participating. As the Astral Express's Supplicant, what kind of changes do you hope to bring to this world in these Games?
rows.speaker: Reporter

rows.text: I shall become its skeleton and allow it to stand.
rows.speaker: Dawnlance

rows.text: That's an impressive answer! Speaking of which, after joining the games, you immediately went to defeat Miss Sparxie, who represented the Masked Fools. What are your thoughts on potentially facing native Supplicants in the future?
rows.speaker: Reporter

rows.text: I shall turn into the fuel that drives it forward!
rows.speaker: Azurewing

rows.text: Speaking of local Supplicants, we've noticed that "Star Rail FEST" is Pearluxe Corp's way of rolling out the red carpet for the Express. There are rumors that the IPC is also sponsoring the Express. So, I have to ask: Are you representing the Express or the IPC in these Games?
rows.speaker: Reporter

rows.text: I shall become the core that makes the engine sing the song of Eternal Joy!
rows.speaker: Blazeweaver

rows.text: Are we... still alive?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I remember the out-of-control Express taking us down and through an abandoned tunnel. Theoretically speaking, this should be a station deep underground.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: But what's with all these ruined buildings and that weird space in the distance? Is this really an underground station? A place this big exists beneath Planarcadia?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Perhaps we're no longer in reality. We may have landed somewhere within the World in Canvas for unknown reasons.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Th—Then, can we still make it back?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: We need to find everyone and get out of here as soon as possible.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Where's Mr. Ashveil and the others?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Aren't you guys a bit late for this?
So, who is this Welt?
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: ...We've been reborn? See, I knew we weren't like those Synwish Syndicate trash.
rows.speaker: Blazeweaver

rows.text: You're right, Red! We're heroes! We are justice! We are the undying happiness!
rows.speaker: Azurewing

rows.text: If you are justice, then forgive me for playing the necessary evil.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Everyone, please, this has to stop! If this goes on, you'll all...
rows.speaker: Cinderborne

rows.text: Just smile! Embrace the everlasting bliss and true happiness.
rows.speaker: Dawnlance

rows.text: I beg you... Please listen to me.
rows.speaker: Cinderborne

rows.text: It's not too late. We can still go back to the Department of Aberration Defense with Miss Kuchiba and explain everything.
rows.speaker: Cinderborne

rows.text: It's no use. They are just creatures that can only react to joy now.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: All shall be blessed with happiness! All shall live forever! So smile, and laugh...
rows.speaker: Blazeweaver

rows.text: And let our laughter infect all of Planarcadia.
rows.speaker: Blazeweaver

rows.text: My senior [Trailblazer], Mr. Ashveil... I'm begging you, please tell them that it's not too late...
rows.speaker: Cinderborne

rows.text: Move aside, Magnus.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Please just give me another minute! You know they're good people...
rows.speaker: Cinderborne

rows.text: It's best if you just move aside.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: A true hero never abandons his friends!
rows.speaker: Cinderborne

rows.text: If I try to kill them now, will you stop me? Or will you turn a blind eye?
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: A tribute of life unto death, and a debt paid in blood.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: The Synwish Syndicate... A gang that once ruled the streets of Dovebrook, they sparked massive turf wars that left many with grievous injuries, and racked up charges for robbery, extortion, and a whole laundry list of other crimes.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Polwave and Caustide... They were far from saints. Any good deeds they did in their lifetimes were just like a few pretty soap bubbles floating up from a stagnant pool of filth.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: That's why we brought them down! They, and this whole world, have now become happier!
rows.speaker: Blazeweaver

rows.text: Yes, they may have had sins to atone for, but that doesn't justify your murdering them as if they were just toys.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Thank you for your aid. I am the Blazeweaver Warrior, captain of the Daybreak Squadron. May I— Hey, where are you going?
rows.speaker: Echo of the Past

rows.text: Play? We're not playing. Everyone's just laughing along happily, hahahaha!
rows.speaker: Dawnlance

rows.text: Mr. Detective, do you know about the Galaxy Rangers? I heard they are a group of righteous heroes roaming the universe. In that sense... are we the city's Rangers?
rows.speaker: Echo of the Past

rows.text: Ah, Mr. Ashveil! Could you do us a favor...
rows.speaker: Echo of the Past

rows.text: This familiar scent... Ah, I see.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Wh—What have you done...
rows.speaker: Cinderborne

rows.text: Remember what happened today, Magnus. You may seek revenge anytime. I won't stop you.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: And so concludes the New Herald of Death case.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: But without evidence or testimony... how am I going to write the closing statement for this report?
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: So did the Daybreak Squadron really do it?
Tell those children... Tell my past self that, when the Herald of Death comes, there will be heroes who put themselves between everyone else and the threat.
rows.speaker: Blazeweaver

rows.text: No one but Ashveil will ever know.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: But I choose to believe him. His "shadow"... only bares its fangs at those drenched in sin.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: I don't know how he came upon such power, but it did help the Department of Aberration Defense crack several hard cases.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: Gray... Are you okay?
Wh—What have we done...
rows.speaker: Cinderborne

rows.text: Just so we're clear, I want you all to forget the name you just heard. Right here and now, in this world called Planarcadia, I am just Detective "Ashveil."
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Come on... Didn't Pearl give you a chip? We're in good hands as long as she can track your location with that thing.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Hahaha. Hahahaha.
Over here. Keep going forward.
Come. Come here.
This way, [Trailblazer].
Come. Embrace this wondrous world. Come to my side.
rows.speaker: Ego (?)

rows.text: You want to go further, deeper. Become one with me. The joy, the positive feedback... Sweet synaptic flickers on your cortex. Gentle. Wonderful.
rows.speaker: Ego (?)

rows.text: Listen. It's breathing, slumbering, whimpering, and grinning.
rows.speaker: Ego (?)

rows.text: Warm. Gentle. Warm. Gentle. Warm. And gentle.
rows.speaker: Ego (?)

rows.text: I am you, and you are me. Come. Embrace this primordial joy.
rows.speaker: Ego (?)

rows.text: Life, in exchange for a boarding pass on the Express toward the end.
rows.speaker: Ego (?)

rows.text: Become one with me. Become a part of me. Become mine...
rows.speaker: Ego (?)

rows.text: Let's go deeper! I want to go over there!
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Come. Come. Come. Come! Just like that, STEP FORWARD!
rows.speaker: Ego (?)

rows.text: That's far enough, [Trailblazer].
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: However, the thing that slumbers in the deep here does look awfully familiar...
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Fulwish's partner.... Perhaps someone far more dangerous has already set their sights on this round of the Phantasmoon Games.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: We meet again, everyone.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Fortunately, [Trailblazer]'s lucky chip helped me locate you.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Please accept my sincerest apologies for not intervening in time and putting all of you in danger.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Actually, she put one in my pocket too, but I auctioned it online as a souvenir. Thank goodness you kept yours, otherwise we'd be done for.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Madam Pearl, where exactly were we just now...?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: What happened?
rows.speaker: Confused Onlooker

rows.text: Look at the moon in the sky... Something is definitely wrong with it!
rows.speaker: Baffled Onlooker

rows.text: The place where you fell is called a "torn scroll." It is a space that peeled from the "scroll painting" during Planarcadia's return to reality. These splintered spaces continuously rip at both reality and the World in Canvas.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: The Department of Aberration Defense originally thought this kind of phenomenon had stabilized... but based on observation: During your encounter with the Daybreak Squadron, there was a sudden spike of disturbances from the "torn scroll." Unfortunately, the cause: unclear.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: You've all fought and worked hard. Please, allow me to apologize again.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Therefore, I had to use the power of the Cornerstone to analyze the space, then mend the fissure with imagenesis in order to bring you out. The Department of Aberration Defense has initiated emergency protocols to reassure the public and handle the aftermath.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: However, I wasn't able to directly observe your situation after you'd fallen into the "torn scroll." Would you be so kind as to share what happened there?
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: We can close the New Herald of Death case. My "shadow" has devoured the guilty three and tasted their sins.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: They were responsible for the Synwish Syndicate massacre. Of that I'm certain.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Was Fulwish the mastermind?
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: I couldn't find any solid proof of it, but it hardly matters now that the culprits have been executed.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Worry not. Based on the intel provided by you and Miss Kuchiba, I have deduced the following:
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: I understand. Your inquiry: How did they manage to operate for so many years unnoticed?
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: As a survivor of the tragedy of the "Bloodstained Games", Fulwish founded the "Research Society of Happy Smiles" charity organization.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Please, be my guest.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: I hope you all get some proper rest before moving out again.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: The organization has since been providing an unapproved medical treatment named "Happiness Surgery" to its members, which neutralizes their physiological capacity to feel pain. The procedure drew many more followers as a result.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: We fought side by side in the past, and I know a few faces. But as they say, the honeymoon phase never lasts.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Some people want the head on my shoulders, while others want the shadow in my arm.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: And the Daybreak Squadron, members of the Smiles Society, imitated the Herald of Death's modus operandi for their crimes, and challenged the Astral Express during the exhibition.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: From the aforementioned facts, the predicted probability of Fulwish being the mastermind is... 92%.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Good answer. I apologize for my presumptuousness. After all, becoming a Ranger comes with loss, suffering, and vengeance.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Good question. I guess old habits die hard when I see someone with potential.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Tiernan is also a senior member of the Express that I respect. I will follow in his footsteps.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: If I may, Madam Pearl. Management in Planarcadia should be dictated by the chain of evidence rather than extrapolated probability.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: Thank you, [Trailblazer]. Mr. Ashveil is right. This is... not the same as playing the hero on a stage.
rows.speaker: Cinderborne

rows.text: Because it's just another Phantasmoon Games for me. Check the records in the Ministry, and you'll see. Save the mythological times, they always end up in a huge mess, without fail.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: Maybe interrogate him for a few days. Get a strong light, render him unable to eat or sleep well, and he will probably spill everything he knows about the Smiles Society.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: I understand. I will observe the human laws and customs.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: In any case, we have achieved our goal through Star Rail FEST: Luring the Supplicant with ill intent out of hiding.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Since Fulwish is exposed now, and we've defeated her Supplicant... shouldn't we hurry and arrest her as soon as possible?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I'm afraid it's not that simple. We've defeated Fulwish's Supplicant, yes, however...
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: All three Daybreak Warriors were Supplicants.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: You were tracking me!
That can't be... The Supplicant should be the only one who wore the mask and participated in the games with the Phantasmoon's blessing.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Those devoured by my "shadow" can no longer lie nor deceive. All three of them had worn the mask before.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: If they were all Supplicants... that means it's still possible for Fulwish to intervene in the games.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: What's even more terrifying is, when the "shadow" devoured them, I caught a taste of something familiar...
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: It was the taste of Abundance that I'd once devoured as a Galaxy Ranger...
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: ...Wuh?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: They were transformed by the Abundance?
Your shadow once ate the Abundance's flesh?
Yes. I didn't think this world would go that far... but I was wrong.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: That's something that... happened a long, long time ago.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Living in seclusion dulls one's senses... I should've realized it earlier, darn it.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: There is no point in beating yourself up over it. Therefore, the conclusion must be corrected: The Research Society's "Happiness Surgery" is a medical technology related to the Abundance, and not simply about relieving pain.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Assessing the risk involved in this procedure...
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: ...Unable to extrapolate.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: General Yao Guang told us that she foresaw a great calamity upon Planarcadia. According to her divinations, Blade, the Stellaron Hunter, could be its catalyst.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: So that's why she asked me for the authority to extradite Blade. Regardless, none of us had anticipated this: Planarcadia's calamity had already taken root, long before the arrival of the Stellaron Hunter.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Then, let's strike Fulwish where it hurts?
That's right, but please get someone else on the job next time!
The Daybreak Squadron has been defeated.
What does Fulwish really want?
In the name of the IPC? The law? Or a challenge to a Supplicant?
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: These options imply three different strategies. Regardless of the approach, the respective timing and investment must be considered.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Does she want revenge against the long-dead Herald of Death?... Or is she trying to erase the memories of that tragedy?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: It's frivolous to speculate her motives. Unlike Intellitrons, humans may weave an intricate plan for a mad reason at any cost, yet execute it with impeccable rationality at every step. What's important is that she is stopped.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Thank you for your "surprise" intel, Mr. Ashveil. You have just saved many more lives.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Henceforth, the Department of Aberration Defense will place Fulwish and the members of the Research Society of Happy Smiles on a special watch list. Given Fulwish's control over media outlets, I recommend closer monitoring of her dissemination channels.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Understood. We will also implement pre-disaster measures at the Calamity-level standard per the Safety Response Protocol Against Aberrant Threats.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: Fulwish is not working alone. For normal people to be able to get an Abundance Transformation, that implies far more sinister supporters behind the scenes. These are enemies not to be easily contended with...
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Therefore, as the Administrator, I beseech you all: Please, lend your aid and help Planarcadia through this crisis!
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: This has escalated beyond mere rivalry for the Aeonic game. Fulwish's conspiracy has crossed the line. This situation's a hundred times more dire than the Herald of Death incident fifteen years ago.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Please, Madam Pearl. This is my home world, and I won't allow the tragedy to repeat itself. Besides, there may be an even greater conspiracy behind all this... As a Nameless, it is my duty to see it through to the end.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: ...Hmph. Indeed, there are old scars and fresh wounds to settle. For the way she toys with life, and the taste of that flesh... Fulwish must be held accountable once and for all.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: You have my eternal gratitude. I won't forget this bond from our shared trials. Now then...
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: I shall prepare an action plan as well as share relevant information with General Yao Guang. The Seed of Abundance planted by Fulwish must be uprooted and eradicated as soon as possible.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: I had put them on a temporary watch list before, due to significant decreases in crime rates in certain regions.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: It's almost time. I should get back to work too.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: Oh, don't be like that. You can tell them that I'm Welt. We already look similar enough. Who knows? Maybe that'll redirect some Wishpower toward your "account" instead?
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: What, itching to get rid of me already? You're not that hasty, are you?
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Such confidence... Heh, can't help but smile at that.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: In that case, I will take back my words. Young Nameless, may you never have to tread the path of a Ranger.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Oh no, they are definitely up to no good.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: You know, I'm not here to be an ornament.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Assessment: You have something to ask me, Mr. Ashveil.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: I won't allow something like that to happen.
Lately, I've been on an extremely lucky streak. Be it Fulwish or Magnus, the leads practically gained sentience and came to me one by one.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Luck is also an important part of one's toolkit. Wouldn't you agree?
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: I'm beginning to think you're the one behind it all. You tasked me to investigate the Society and protect the Astral Express, which all led to me unleashing my shadow on those people... just so you can confirm your hypothesis.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: ...You had everything planned out since the beginning, hadn't you?
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: If I answer "Yes," would it wound your ego?
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: ...Perhaps.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Yes. I paved the way for your investigation, leading you straight to the suspects.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Through you, I confirmed my suspicions about the Research Society. However, the question of Abundance Transformation remains a thorny issue for me.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Does Fulwish really think she could win?
Fortunately, there's a ranger who specializes in confronting such abominations, having lived in long seclusion within Planarcadia.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Hmph...
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: But you know the "shadow" sealed inside my arm... can be very dangerous.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Simply removing the nail can cause it to stir and resonate with the "torn scroll" and fissure.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Had I not kept it under control at that time, the fight would have ended with all of us buried in that bottomless abyss. Is that part of your plans too, Pearl?
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Moments later, in some corner of the city...
Humans fear the worst, but to the Intellitrons, such fears are merely irrational deterrents.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Wasn't the Mask of Elation I gave you enough to pin down the "shadow"?
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: That Gift you found through the guidance of the Express Navigator, "Starseer", Isee.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: That very shadow that devoured the Swarm and Lord Ravager Zulo ten Amber Eras ago.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: That very shadow that devoured Shuhu, the Emanator of Abundance, hundreds of years ago.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: You won the bet. You sure know a lot about this.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Please allow me to correct you. My ethical parameters prohibit engagement in probabilistic gambits. Accordingly, I operate by acquiring sufficient information to ensure zero margin for error.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Then again, you are the species that brought "art" into existence as a form of expression. That seed of creation exists even in the most ignorant of humans' minds, and for that, I love and admire you.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Whether you believe or not, I will honor our initial agreement, Mr. La Mancha. At the moment of victory in the Phantasmoon Games, I will free you from all sufferings and fulfill your wish—
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: "To let a Galaxy Ranger die peacefully in his bed."
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: In that case, I will continue to fight for you, my lady.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Oh, right.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: You mentioned several times wanting to replicate the works of Graphia. I don't know much about art...
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: But I was considering that, despite the lack of artistic quality in your strokes when sealing those fissures today, to the people of this world...
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Your creation is just as important as the works of Graphia. Not a single innocent soul was lost on this day because of your protection.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Looking back to the ancestral painter of the Cindearth Age, do you truly think she cared about the artistic value of each stroke when she created World in Canvas?
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Tsk, but what do I know... These are just crude observations from an amateur, so pay them no mind. I'll be on my way!
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: We meet again, Ashen Detective.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: It's hard to believe that I came back for you, especially after learning that you wanted to sell me out to Pearl...
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: Gotta thank nature's gift. The 6.1 billion credits reward has appeared again.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Fortunately, I bypassed you and struck a deal with that Intellitron instead. Regrettably, my current bounty stands at zero.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: Do you always turn your customers over to the police? How impressively short-sighted. No wonder your clientele is so small.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: Speaking of short-sightedness, no one rivals the Stellaron Hunters, a.k.a. Destiny's Slaves, isn't it? You are all fated to march toward the Finality, and nothing can stop you.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: On the contrary, there are many paths for us, as long as {RUBY_B#Elio}that person{RUBY_E#} can see.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: In other words, he can't see the trajectory of your destiny in this world during this mission?
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Take a guess.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: I've heard what befell Amphoreus. The war among the Aeons is now inevitable... Whether it's the IPC or the Express, they are fighting for an uncertain future.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: And in the world where the Elation is the Center of Attention, there will eventually be more than one Aeon interfering. Even a Destiny's Slave would not be able to see the path ahead.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Keep guessing. We're getting pretty close.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: Enough of your games. I'd say it's not too late to rename the planet Adlivun.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: It's still too early to despair, old man. I came prepared... but I could use a helping hand.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: 30 million credits. Pay or die.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Come on, give your friend a discount, will you? Say... zero credits?
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: I ain't your friend.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: I meant him.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: It's been a while, Yingxing.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: It's been too long, Mr. La Mancha.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: ...I knew it. There must be an explanation for the unusual fate of this world.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: Though I lost sight of the sparrow, I discovered a mysterious tree. I've finally found the heart of the Phantasmoon Games, thanks to this little birdie.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: (Mr. Sunday, do you sense me?)
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: There's no reaction from the bird. What's wrong with it?
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: Hello? Is anyone there? Can I get somebody here?
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: No one's here... No one—
rows.speaker: Resonance All Around

rows.text: That's a lie. I saw a pretty girl hiding right here through the bird's eyes. Who are you?
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: That's none of your business... None of your business...
rows.speaker: Resonance All Around

rows.text: If that's how it's going to be, then I'm done playing nice here.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: If my eyes weren't playing tricks on me, the ancient tree here must be the Ambrosial Arbor of Abundance, yes?
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: Little girl, are you going to keep playing hide-and-seek, or will you come out and have a proper conversation with me?
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: The Department of Aberration Defense often comes here to record game progress, and now even my movements have been exposed to complete outsiders... I suppose it's time to leave.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: You sound unpleasant to talk to, but since you have eyes keen enough to tell what I am at a glance, I'll have a short chat with you.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: I will answer three questions, so ask away. Once you have your answers, I'm going to show you the door.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: On my second question, are you a Faekind native to Ahatopia, or are you... one of the long-life species shaped by the Ambrosial Arbor?
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: Aren't you good at divination? Can you help me take a look whether the slip on my head says weal or woe?
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: There's nothing on your head except your ears.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: And that itself is the answer.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: I am the arbitrator who determines the outcome of the Phantasmoon Games. I am the raging waves of joy and the living pulse of this world.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Diviner of the Xianzhou, the weal and woe you behold are but a single petal fallen from my hand. It blooms with the morning and withers by evening, reducing to dust in a fleeting moment. My true form is the Panarch Elwood, the embodiment of "instant" and "eternity."
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Interesting. Took you quite some time to come up with those words, huh?
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: The one who created me did say most people wouldn't believe me. Tch, turns out THEY were right...
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: I believe you. I feel the same way, for many do not trust the words of a diviner. Besides, no weal or woe has befallen you, which means your fate cannot be determined like that of ordinary mortals. You're not the first one I've met with this condition since my arrival here.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: You're left with one question.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Since you admit to being an abomination of Abundance... Shouldn't you explain the fate of this world's residents...?
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: ...Unless they are your doing? If your answer fails to convince me...
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: It may be too late by the time I summon the Lux Arrow from the sky with the Reignbow.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: Chill out! You shouldn't make jokes like this.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: I'm not as skilled at divination as you are. When you suddenly speak of the great weal or woe and interrogate me, I get confused too...
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: I wanted to question why the {RUBY_B#Aha}Joyseeker{RUBY_E#} would permit the Ambrosial Arbor of Abundance to take root in a world THEY had blessed, but given THEIR carefree nature, there was probably never any restriction to begin with.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: After all, isn't every rule and every variable of the Phantasmoon Games dictated by the impulse of some god?
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: As for the brewing storm... let's settle down and discuss...
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Whether the turmoil once again is the result of the Laughter's mischief?
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: This entire day has felt... unreal.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: We had situations lined up one after another, and a growing crisis on our hands.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: The Research Society is insane to meddle with the power of Abundance. There's no telling how many have already undergone the Happiness Surgery...
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Fulwish witnessed the tragedy caused by the Herald of Death fifteen years ago, and now she herself has assumed that dreadful mantle.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: We have to relay this information to Dan Heng, Sunday, and General Yao Guang as soon as possible.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Fulwish is definitely aware of the enemies she's facing.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: That is why we must win an audience with Aha. At the very least, we need to stop Fulwish from winning the game.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Yeah. The thought of the Research Society of Happy Smiles going through with their plan gives me the chills...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: It's been a long day, and all of you must be very tired. Take this chance to get some proper rest. I'll go meet Welt back on the Express. March, [Trailblazer], what about you?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: The best way to recharge is to waste time, so I'm staying outside for some fresh air.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Sounds good. I was thinking of heading to the streets for a walk.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: No, I heard it... You must have misheard...
rows.speaker: Bustling Crowd

rows.text: I wasn't kidding. The moon was laughing... I'm just here to join the fun... I bet you misheard it...
rows.speaker: Bustling Crowd

rows.text: What's happening?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Hey there! All the smarties and dummies, children and adults, Fools and entertainers, can you all hear me?
rows.speaker: Phantasmoon
